jobs.title: Area Sales Manager Europe, High Power Solution Business Line (flexible location)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Global Channel Sales & Sales Manager Hub Europe

__

Your role and responsibilities

We are looking for an experienced sales professional with new business development focus to take up commercial and operational responsibility for the assigned countries in Europe. In this role, you will drive sustainable growth by enabling local sales teams with market intelligence, offer/tendering leadership and strong customer engagement, while ensuring disciplined planning, forecasting, and governance on strategic opportunities and long term account development.

The work model for the role is: hybrid ; #LI-Hybrid

The role is contributing to the Motion High Power division in globally.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Sales Strategy & Performance Ownership: Leading regional sales planning end-to-end, setting and executing targets, managing key accounts, and driving growth through structured account development and budget discipline.

  • Offer Leadership & Deal Execution: Overseeing complex pursuit processes, coordinating cross-functional teams, and delivering competitive, high-quality proposals to maximize win rates.

  • Forecasting, Pipeline & Profitability Management: Ensuring accurate forecasting and strong pipeline health, driving corrective actions, and optimizing pricing, margins, and sales mix for sustainable performance.

  • Customer Engagement & Market Insight: Engaging customers through technical discussions and negotiations, while leveraging market and competitor intelligence to shape strategy and strengthen positioning.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Minimum 8-10 years of professional experience in Sales & Marketing or other relevant fields.

  • Knowledge of large electric drives and motors technology and applications.

  • International experience in dealing with global companies with decision makers located in different regions and matrix organizations.

  • BS/MS Degree in Engineering, Business, or Marketing.

  • Strong strategic sales & commercial acumen (pricing, margins, deal structuring), with a focus on new business development.

  • Proven tender/pursuit leadership for complex, high-value solution deals.

  • Advanced stakeholder management & influencing skills in a matrix organization.

  • Excellent data-driven pipeline & forecasting discipline (e.g., SFDC).

  • Ability in customer value selling & high-level negotiations (technical + commercial).

  • Solid influencing skills, flexibility and well accustomed to long sales cycles.

  • Fluent English language skills.

More about us

ABB High Power is a global supplier of high-performance drives, drive systems and packages for industrial processes and large infrastructure applications. With our advanced technology and global support, we help our customers, partners and equipment manufacturers with asset reliability, performance improvement and energy efficiency in mission critical applications. Our people and culture are the foundation of our growth. We all together make the difference for our customers every day.

We value people from different backgrounds. Apply today for your next career step within ABB and visit www.abb.com to learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe. #MyABBStory

We look forward to receiving your application (documents submitted in English are appreciated). If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Bei ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder Mensch hier macht das möglich. Sie werden in der Lage sein zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie, das zu führen, was die Welt regiert. Diese Position berichtet an: Global Channel Sales & Sales Manager Hub Europe Ihre Rolle und Verantwortung Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Vertriebsprofi mit neuem Fokus auf Geschäftsentwicklung, der kaufmännische und operative Verantwortung für die zugewiesenen Länder in Europa übernimmt. In dieser Rolle werden Sie ein nachhaltiges Wachstum vorantreiben, indem Sie lokale Vertriebsteams mit Marktinformationen, einer Führungsrolle im Bereich Angebot/Ausschreibung und einer starken Kundenbindung ausstatten und gleichzeitig eine disziplinierte Planung, Prognose und Governance für strategische Chancen und langfristige Kontoentwicklung sicherstellen. Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle ist: hybrid ; #LI-Hybrid Die Rolle trägt zur Motion High Power Division weltweit bei. Sie sind hauptsächlich verantwortlich für: - Sales Strategy & Performance Ownership: Führen der regionalen Vertriebsplanung Ende-zu-Ende, Setzen und Ausführen von Zielen, Verwalten von Schlüsselkonten und Wachstum durch strukturierte Kontoentwicklung und Budgetdisziplin. - Leadership & Deal Execution anbieten: Überwachung komplexer Verfolgungsprozesse, Koordination funktionsübergreifender Teams und Bereitstellung wettbewerbsfähiger, qualitativ hochwertiger Vorschläge zur Maximierung der Gewinnraten. - Forecasting, Pipeline & Profitability Management: Sicherstellen einer genauen Prognose und einer starken Pipeline-Gesundheit, Förderung von Korrekturmaßnahmen und Optimierung von Preisen, Margen und Verkaufsmix für nachhaltige Leistung. Customer Engagement & Market Insight: Kunden durch technische Diskussionen und Verhandlungen einbeziehen und gleichzeitig Markt- und Wettbewerberinformationen nutzen, um die Strategie zu gestalten und die Positionierung zu stärken.
• Qualifikationen für die Rolle - Mindestens 8-10 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Sales & Marketing oder anderen relevanten Bereichen. - Wissen über große elektrische Antriebe und Motoren Technologie und Anwendungen. - Internationale Erfahrung im Umgang mit globalen Unternehmen mit Entscheidungsträgern in verschiedenen Regionen und Matrixorganisationen. - BS / MS Degree in Engineering, Business oder Marketing. - Starker strategischer Vertriebs- und Geschäftssinn (Preisgestaltung, Margen, Dealstrukturierung) mit Schwerpunkt auf der Entwicklung neuer Geschäftsbereiche. Bewährte Tender- / Pursuit-Führung für komplexe, hochwertige Lösungsangebote. - Fortgeschrittenes Stakeholder-Management & Einfluss auf Fähigkeiten in einer Matrixorganisation. - Hervorragende datengesteuerte Pipeline- und Prognosedisziplin (z. B. SFDC). - Fähigkeit zum Verkauf von Kundenwerten und Verhandlungen auf hoher Ebene (technisch + kommerziell). - Solide Einflussfähigkeiten, Flexibilität und gut an lange Verkaufszyklen gewöhnt. - fließende Englischkenntnisse. ABB High Power ist ein globaler Anbieter von Hochleistungsantrieben, Antriebssystemen und Paketen für industrielle Prozesse und große Infrastrukturanwendungen. Mit unserer fortschrittlichen Technologie und unserem globalen Support unterstützen wir unsere Kunden, Partner und Gerätehersteller bei der Zuverlässigkeit von Anlagen, Leistungsverbesserung und Energieeffizienz in geschäftskritischen Anwendungen. Unsere Menschen und unsere Kultur sind die Grundlage unseres Wachstums. Wir alle machen jeden Tag den Unterschied für unsere Kunden. Wir schätzen Menschen mit unterschiedlichem Hintergrund. Bewerben Sie sich noch heute für Ihren nächsten Karriereschritt bei ABB und besuchen Sie www.abb.com, um sich über die Auswirkungen unserer Lösungen auf der ganzen Welt zu informieren. #MyABBStory Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung (auf Englisch eingereichte Dokumente werden geschätzt). Wenn Sie mehr über ABB erfahren möchten, werfen Sie einen weiteren Blick auf unsere Website www.abb.com. Der Aufbau einer saubereren, intelligenteren Zukunft erfordert alle Arten von Köpfen: das Neugierige, das Mutige und das Kreative. Deshalb begrüßen wir Menschen mit allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen. Bereit, eine Wirkung zu erzielen? Bewerben Sie sich noch heute oder besuchen Sie https://www.abb.com, um mehr über die Auswirkungen unserer Lösungen auf der ganzen Welt zu erfahren.

Chez ABB , nous aidons les industries à fonctionner plus minces et plus propres, et chaque personne ici fait que cela arrive. Vous aurez le pouvoir de diriger, de soutenir la croissance et d'être fiers de l'impact que nous créons ensemble. Rejoignez-nous et aidez à gérer ce qui dirige le monde. Ce poste relève de: Global Channel Sales & Sales Manager Hub Europe Votre rôle et vos responsabilités Nous sommes à la recherche d'un professionnel des ventes expérimenté avec une nouvelle orientation du développement des entreprises pour assumer la responsabilité commerciale et opérationnelle des pays affectés en Europe. Dans ce rôle, vous stimulerez la croissance durable en permettant aux équipes de vente locales d'avoir des renseignements sur le marché, d'offrir/d'offrir un leadership et une forte participation des clients, tout en assurant une planification, des prévisions et une gouvernance disciplinées sur les opportunités stratégiques et le développement de comptes à long terme. Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est : hybride ; #LI-Hybrid Ce rôle contribue à la division de la haute puissance de la motion dans le monde entier. Vous serez principalement responsable : - de la stratégie commerciale et de la propriété des performances : de la planification des ventes régionales de bout en bout, de la définition et de l'exécution des objectifs, de la gestion des comptes clés et de la stimulation de la croissance grâce au développement structuré des comptes et à la discipline budgétaire. - Offre Leadership & Deal Execution: Superviser les processus de poursuite complexes, coordonner les équipes interfonctionnelles, et fournir des propositions compétitives et de haute qualité pour maximiser les taux de réussite. - Gestion des prévisions, des pipelines et de la rentabilité : assurer des prévisions précises et une bonne santé des pipelines, prendre des mesures correctives et optimiser les prix, les marges et le dosage des ventes pour une performance durable. - Engagement des clients et vision du marché : engager les clients au moyen de discussions et de négociations techniques, tout en tirant parti de l'intelligence du marché et des concurrents pour façonner la stratégie et renforcer le positionnement.
• Qualifications pour le rôle - Minimum 8-10 ans d'expérience professionnelle dans les ventes & marketing ou d'autres domaines pertinents. - Connaissance de la technologie et des applications des gros moteurs électriques. - Expérience internationale dans les relations avec des entreprises mondiales avec des décideurs situés dans différentes régions et organisations matricielles. - Baccalauréat en génie, commerce ou marketing. - Forte concentration stratégique des ventes et du commerce (prix, marges, structuration des transactions), avec un accent sur le développement de nouvelles entreprises. - Un leadership éprouvé pour les offres de solutions complexes et de grande valeur. - Gestion avancée des intervenants et influence des compétences dans une organisation matricielle. - Excellente discipline de pipeline et de prévision fondée sur les données (par exemple, SFDC). - Capacité de vente de valeur client & négociations de haut niveau (technique + commerciale). - Solides compétences d'influence, flexibilité et bien habitué aux longs cycles de vente. - Compétences linguistiques. En savoir plus sur nous ABB High Power est un fournisseur mondial d'entraînements, de systèmes d'entraînement et de paquets haute performance pour les processus industriels et les grandes applications d'infrastructure. Grâce à notre technologie de pointe et à notre soutien mondial, nous aidons nos clients, nos partenaires et nos fabricants d'équipements en matière de fiabilité des actifs, d'amélioration des performances et d'efficacité énergétique dans les applications critiques. Notre peuple et notre culture sont les fondements de notre croissance. Nous faisons tous la différence pour nos clients tous les jours. Nous apprécions les gens de différents horizons. Faites une demande aujourd'hui pour votre prochaine étape de carrière au sein d'ABB et visitez www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur l'impact de nos solutions à travers le monde. Mon histoire Nous sommes impatients de recevoir votre demande (les documents présentés en anglais sont appréciés). Si vous voulez en savoir plus sur ABB, consultez notre site www.abb.com . C'est pourquoi nous accueillons des gens de tous horizons et expériences. Prêt à faire un impact ? jobs.title: R&D (Senior)Testing & Lab Engineer
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Team Lead

__

Your role and responsibilities

The mission of this team is to bring modern and disruptive power electronic solutions from research into product development. We improve our products by holistic optimization, pushing forward novel converter topologies as well as optimizing key components. By joining us, you will participate in idea generation at the frontier of academic research and industrial applications, as well as in the development of advanced technologies for ABB’s products.

Do you want to contribute to a greener future by utilizing advanced and highly efficient power-electronic solutions for various applications? Get in touch with us! A young, multinational team is looking forward to welcoming you as their latest team member!

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

The main responsibilities include

  • Own the lab infrastructure (Laborinfrastruktur), including coordination with maintenance (Instandhaltung), organizing calibration (Kalibrierung) of equipment, and managing lab supplies (Verbrauchsmaterialien).
  • Ensure lab safety (Sicherheit) and organize/structure lab spaces for multiple ongoing projects.
  • Support scientific work by designing and building power electronics prototypes (Leistungselektronik Prototypen) up to medium voltage (Mittelspannung) and megawatt power.
  • Assist in commissioning test setups (Inbetriebnahme von Prüfaufbauten) and perform testing together with scientific staff (Wissenschaftler).
  • Collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders (Teamfähigkeit), and supervise apprentices (Lernende / Auszubildende) in daily tasks.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Completed apprenticeship as an automation technician (Automatiker EFZ) with practical experience in machining (Fräsen, Bohren, Drehen, Handarbeit), and be able to conversate in English.
  • Additional education from a Higher Technical School or University of Applied Sciences (Höhere Fachschule HF / Fachhochschule FH) in power electronics, energy systems, or similar is a strong advantage.
  • Experience with CAD design (CAD-Konstruktion) using tools such as Creo, Solid Edge, SolidWorks, or equivalent; PCB design (Leiterplattendesign) knowledge is a plus (Altium Designer).
  • Solid experience in electrical circuit design (Schaltungsdesign), grounding concepts (Erdung), and wiring standards (Verdrahtungsrichtlinien).
  • Hands-on experience building and prototyping power electronic systems (Leistungselektronik Systeme), including mechanical work, tooling (Werkzeuge), and implementing ad-hoc improvements.
  • Basic knowledge of electrical standards (e.g., NIV / NIN / SNR 464022) and familiarity with lab technologies such as 3D printing (3D-Druck), LabVIEW, and laser cutting/engraving (Laserschneider / Lasergravur).

More about us

At the ABB research center in Baden-Dättwil in the proximity of Zurich, we work on exciting technologies that shape the future of our products. Our international research teams focus on Power Electronics, Energy Storage, Intelligent Systems, and Switching.

We look forward to receiving your application.

  • Assist in commissioning test setups (Inbetriebnahme von Prüfaufbauten) and perform testing together with scientific staff (Wissenschaftler).
  • Collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders (Teamfähigkeit), and supervise apprentices (Lernende / Auszubildende) in daily tasks.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Completed apprenticeship as an automation technician (Automatiker EFZ) with practical experience in machining (Fräsen, Bohren, Drehen, Handarbeit), and be able to conversate in English.
  • Additional education from a Higher Technical School or University of Applied Sciences (Höhere Fachschule HF / Fachhochschule FH) in power electronics, energy systems, or similar is a strong advantage.
  • Experience with CAD design (CAD-Konstruktion) using tools such as Creo, Solid Edge, SolidWorks, or equivalent; PCB design (Leiterplattendesign) knowledge is a plus (Altium Designer).
  • Solid experience in electrical circuit design (Schaltungsdesign), grounding concepts (Erdung), and wiring standards (Verdrahtungsrichtlinien).
  • Hands-on experience building and prototyping power electronic systems (Leistungselektronik Systeme), including mechanical work, tooling (Werkzeuge), and implementing ad-hoc improvements.
  • Basic knowledge of electrical standards (e.g., NIV / NIN / SNR 464022) and familiarity with lab technologies such as 3D printing (3D-Druck), LabVIEW, and laser cutting/engraving (Laserschneider / Lasergravur).

More about us

At the ABB research center in Baden-Dättwil in the proximity of Zurich, we work on exciting technologies that shape the future of our products. Our international research teams focus on Power Electronics, Energy Storage, Intelligent Systems, and Switching.

We look forward to receiving your application.

jobs.title: Group Government Relations & Public Affairs Manager
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Govt Relations & Public Affairs Mgr.

__

Your role and responsibilities:

As part of ABB’s Group Government Relations & Public Affairs (GRPA) team, you will support the development and execution of ABB’s global GRPA strategy. You will contribute to high-level advocacy with policymakers, advance strategic partnerships with external stakeholders, and support senior leadership visibility on key public policy platforms. The role reports to the Director of Policy and Partnerships and is based in Zurich.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

  • Stakeholder engagement, partnerships and advocacy: Support engagement on priority policy topics with governments, international organizations, trade associations, and industry platforms. Contribute to stakeholder mapping, prepare briefings and messaging, organize meetings and events, and manage follow-up actions. Support the strategic direction and day-to-day management of public affairs partnerships, and represent ABB’s policy positions in external fora and internal cross-functional teams.

  • Senior leadership support: Contribute to delivery of high-quality materials for leadership engagements, including briefings, talking points, scripts, and presentations, in close collaboration with relevant teams.

  • Messaging and narratives: Contribute to the development of messaging aligned with ABB’s policy priorities, ensuring consistency with and support of business strategy.

  • Policy monitoring and strategic insights: Monitor policy trends, industry developments, and geopolitical changes to inform engagement strategies. Identify risks and opportunities (e.g., energy transition, industrial policy, digitalization, AI) and translate complex developments into clear, actionable insights and internal briefings.

  • GRPA operations and collaboration: Support annual strategic planning, enhance workflows and knowledge management, and drive the adoption of digital and AI tools to improve team performance. Contribute to global GRPA communities of practice and knowledge-sharing initiatives.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Master’s degree (completed or near completed) in International Affairs, Political Science, Public Policy, Business Administration, or a related field.

  • Between 2 and 5 years of experience in government relations, public affairs, consulting, public sector, or international organizations, with a keen interest in geopolitics, public policy and business–government relations.

  • Understanding of key policy areas relevant to ABB, such as energy, digitalization, and industrial policy, is an advantage.

  • Well-developed research and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to translate complex topics into clear, concise materials for senior audiences.

  • Solid organizational skills, ability to manage multiple priorities, and strong interpersonal skills to engage effectively with diverse stakeholders.

  • High level of ownership, with a curious, solution-oriented, and engaged approach, interest in digital

  • Solid written and presentation skills in English are essential.

More about us:

We are ABB’s Group Government Relations & Public Affairs team, representing ABB globally by engaging policymakers, building strategic partnerships, and shaping policy conversations to support the company’s leadership in electrification, sustainability, automation, and innovation.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Questa posizione riporta a:
Govt Relations & Public Affairs Mons.

Non lo so.

Il tuo ruolo e le tue responsabilità:

Nell’ambito del team ABB’s Group Government Relations & Public Affairs (GRPA), supporterai lo sviluppo e l’esecuzione della strategia globale GRPA di ABB. Contribuirai all'advocacy di alto livello con i responsabili politici, alle partnership strategiche avanzate con gli stakeholder esterni e supporterai la visibilità della leadership senior sulle principali piattaforme di politica pubblica. Il ruolo segnala al direttore della politica e dei partenariati e si basa a Zurigo.

Il modello di lavoro per il ruolo è: ibrido

- No.
Impegno degli stakeholder, partenariati e advocacy: impegno di sostegno su temi prioritari di politica con governi, organizzazioni internazionali, associazioni di categoria e piattaforme industriali. Contribuire alla mappatura delle parti interessate, preparare briefing e messaggistica, organizzare riunioni ed eventi e gestire le azioni di follow-up. Sostenere la direzione strategica e la gestione quotidiana dei partenariati degli affari pubblici, e rappresentare le posizioni politiche di ABB in team esterni e interfunzionali interni.

- No.

- No.
Messaging e narrazioni: Contribuire allo sviluppo della messaggistica allineato alle priorità politiche di ABB, garantendo coerenza e supporto della strategia aziendale.

- No.

Contribuire alle comunità globali di GRPA di pratiche e iniziative di condivisione delle conoscenze.

Laurea magistrale (completato o presso completato) in Affari Internazionali, Scienze Politiche, Politica Pubblica, Business Administration, o un campo relativo.

Tra i 2 e i 5 anni di esperienza nelle relazioni governative, negli affari pubblici, nella consulenza, nel settore pubblico o nelle organizzazioni internazionali, con un vivo interesse per la geopolitica, la politica pubblica e le relazioni commerciali-governative.

- No.
La comprensione di settori chiave di politica rilevanti per ABB, come l'energia, la digitalizzazione e la politica industriale, è un vantaggio.

- No.
Ricerca ben sviluppata e capacità di problem solving, con la capacità di tradurre argomenti complessi in materiali chiari e concisi per il pubblico senior.

Competenze organizzative solide, capacità di gestire più priorità e forti capacità interpersonali per impegnarsi efficacemente con diversi stakeholder.

- No.
Alto livello di proprietà, con un approccio curioso, orientato alla soluzione e impegnato, interesse per il digitale

- No.
Le solide competenze scritte e di presentazione in inglese sono essenziali.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder Mensch hier macht das möglich. Sie werden in der Lage sein zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie, das zu führen, was die Welt regiert. Diese Position berichtet an: Govt Relations & Public Affairs Mgr. Ihre Rolle und Verantwortlichkeiten: Als Teil des Group Government Relations & Public Affairs (GRPA) Teams von ABB unterstützen Sie die Entwicklung und Umsetzung der globalen GRPA-Strategie von ABB. Sie tragen zu einer hochrangigen Interessenvertretung bei politischen Entscheidungsträgern bei, fördern strategische Partnerschaften mit externen Interessengruppen und unterstützen die Sichtbarkeit von Führungskräften auf wichtigen politischen Plattformen. Die Rolle berichtet an den Direktor für Politik und Partnerschaften und hat ihren Sitz in Zürich. Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle ist: hybrid - Stakeholder-Engagement, Partnerschaften und Interessenvertretung: Unterstützung des Engagements bei prioritären politischen Themen mit Regierungen, internationalen Organisationen, Handelsverbänden und Branchenplattformen. Tragen Sie zum Stakeholder-Mapping bei, bereiten Sie Briefings und Messaging vor, organisieren Sie Meetings und Veranstaltungen und verwalten Sie Folgeaktionen. Unterstützen Sie die strategische Ausrichtung und das tägliche Management von Public Affairs-Partnerschaften und vertreten Sie die politischen Positionen von ABB in externen Foren und internen funktionsübergreifenden Teams. Senior Leadership Support: Tragen Sie zur Bereitstellung hochwertiger Materialien für Führungsaufgaben bei, einschließlich Briefings, Gesprächsthemen, Skripte und Präsentationen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit relevanten Teams. - Messaging und Erzählungen : Beitrag zur Entwicklung von Messaging, das auf die politischen Prioritäten von ABB ausgerichtet ist, um die Kohärenz mit und die Unterstützung der Geschäftsstrategie sicherzustellen. Politiküberwachung und strategische Erkenntnisse: Überwachen Sie politische Trends, Branchenentwicklungen und geopolitische Veränderungen, um Engagement-Strategien zu informieren. Identifizieren Sie Risiken und Chancen (z.B. Energiewende, Industriepolitik, Digitalisierung, KI) und übersetzen Sie komplexe Entwicklungen in klare, umsetzbare Erkenntnisse und interne Briefings. GRPA-Betrieb und Zusammenarbeit: Unterstützung der jährlichen strategischen Planung, Verbesserung der Workflows und des Wissensmanagements und Förderung der Einführung digitaler und KI-Tools zur Verbesserung der Teamleistung. Beitrag zu globalen GRPA-Praxisgemeinschaften und Initiativen zum Wissensaustausch.
• Qualifikationen für die Rolle - Master-Abschluss (abgeschlossen oder fast abgeschlossen) in International Affairs, Politikwissenschaft, Public Policy, Business Administration oder einem verwandten Bereich. - Zwischen 2 und 5 Jahren Erfahrung in Regierungsbeziehungen, Public Affairs, Beratung, öffentlichem Sektor oder internationalen Organisationen, mit einem scharfen Interesse an Geopolitik, Public Policy und Geschäfts-Regierungsbeziehungen. - Das Verständnis der für ABB relevanten Politikfelder wie Energie, Digitalisierung und Industriepolitik ist von Vorteil. - Gut entwickelte Forschungs- und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Themen in klare, prägnante Materialien für Senioren zu übersetzen. Solide organisatorische Fähigkeiten, die Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten zu verwalten, und starke zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten, um effektiv mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern zu interagieren. - Hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung, mit einem neugierigen, lösungsorientierten und engagierten Ansatz, Interesse an Digital - Solide schriftliche und Präsentationsfähigkeiten in Englisch sind unerlässlich. Mehr über uns: Wir sind das Group Government Relations & Public Affairs-Team von ABB und vertreten ABB weltweit, indem wir politische Entscheidungsträger einbeziehen, strategische Partnerschaften aufbauen und politische Gespräche gestalten, um die Führungsrolle des Unternehmens in den Bereichen Elektrifizierung, Nachhaltigkeit, Automatisierung und Innovation zu unterstützen. Der Aufbau einer saubereren, intelligenteren Zukunft erfordert alle Arten von Köpfen: das Neugierige, das Mutige und das Kreative. Deshalb begrüßen wir Menschen mit allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen. Bereit, eine Wirkung zu erzielen? Bewerben Sie sich noch heute oder besuchen Sie https://www.abb.com, um mehr über die Auswirkungen unserer Lösungen auf der ganzen Welt zu erfahren.

Chez ABB , nous aidons les industries à fonctionner plus minces et plus propres, et chaque personne ici fait que cela arrive. Vous aurez le pouvoir de diriger, de soutenir la croissance et d'être fiers de l'impact que nous créons ensemble. Rejoignez-nous et aidez à gérer ce qui dirige le monde.

Cette position porte sur :
Relations gouvernementales et affaires publiques

Votre rôle et vos responsabilités :

Dans le cadre de l'équipe du Groupe Relations gouvernementales et affaires publiques (GRPA), vous soutiendrez le développement et l'exécution de la stratégie globale GRPA d'ABB. Vous contribuerez à des activités de sensibilisation de haut niveau avec les décideurs, favoriserez les partenariats stratégiques avec les intervenants externes et favoriserez la visibilité des dirigeants sur les principales plateformes de politiques publiques. Ce rôle relève du Directeur des politiques et des partenariats et est basé à Zurich.

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est: hybride

- Oui.
Engagement des parties prenantes, partenariats et plaidoyer : Soutenir l'engagement sur des sujets prioritaires avec les gouvernements, les organisations internationales, les associations professionnelles et les plateformes industrielles. Contribuer à la cartographie des intervenants, préparer des séances d'information et des messages, organiser des réunions et des événements et gérer les mesures de suivi. Soutenir l'orientation stratégique et la gestion quotidienne des partenariats pour les affaires publiques, et représenter les positions politiques de l'ABB dans les forums externes et les équipes interfonctionnelles internes.

- Oui.
Soutien aux cadres supérieurs : Contribuer à la livraison de matériel de haute qualité pour les engagements en leadership, y compris des séances d'information, des points de discussion, des scénarios et des présentations, en étroite collaboration avec les équipes compétentes.

- Oui.
Messagerie et narrations : Contribuer au développement de messages alignés sur les priorités politiques d'ABB, en assurant la cohérence avec et le soutien de la stratégie d'affaires.

- Oui.
Suivi des politiques et perspectives stratégiques : suivre les tendances politiques, l'évolution de l'industrie et les changements géopolitiques pour éclairer les stratégies d'engagement. Recenser les risques et les possibilités (p. ex. transition énergétique, politique industrielle, numérisation, AI) et traduire les développements complexes en idées claires et réalisables et en séances d'information internes.

- Oui.
Exploitation et collaboration du GRPA : Soutenir la planification stratégique annuelle, améliorer les flux de travail et la gestion des connaissances, et favoriser l'adoption d'outils numériques et d'IA pour améliorer les performances de l'équipe. Contribuer aux initiatives des communautés mondiales de pratiques et de partage des connaissances dans le cadre de l'APGR.

• Qualifications pour le rôle

- Oui.
Maîtrise (achevée ou presque terminée) en affaires internationales, sciences politiques, politiques publiques, administration des affaires ou un domaine connexe.

- Oui.
Entre 2 et 5 ans d'expérience dans les relations gouvernementales, les affaires publiques, la consultation, le secteur public ou les organisations internationales, avec un vif intérêt pour la géopolitique, les politiques publiques et les relations entre les entreprises et les gouvernements.

- Oui.
La compréhension des principaux domaines d'action de l'ABB, comme l'énergie, la numérisation et la politique industrielle, est un avantage.

- Oui.
Capacités de recherche et de résolution de problèmes bien développées, avec la capacité de traduire des sujets complexes en documents clairs et concis pour les aînés.

- Oui.
Des compétences organisationnelles solides, la capacité de gérer de multiples priorités et des compétences interpersonnelles solides pour collaborer efficacement avec divers intervenants.

- Oui.

jobs.title: Internship in Computer Vision for Marine and Ports (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Senior Engineer

__

ABB Corporate Research, in close collaboration with its different business areas, is developing the foundations for the next generation of ABB products. We would like to give a motivated student an opportunity to complete a six-month internship with a multidisciplinary team at the Sensing and Analytics group of ABB.

At ABB, we envisioned future marine and port operations that are safer, more efficient, and more sustainable. To realize this future, we are developing advanced technological solutions that are based on various sensing modalities.

During this internship, you will have an opportunity to work on different aspects of a system for marine and port automation. The focus is on machine learning algorithms. You will work with synthetic and real-world data from various sensors (e.g., camera or LiDAR).

Your role and responsibilities

  • Exploration of current challenges in Marine or Ports via direct interaction with ABB R&D units

  • Review of academic literature

  • Design, evaluation and documentation of potential solutions

  • Quick prototyping of solutions through proof-of-concept implementations

• Qualifications for the role

  • Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology or similar field; enrollment to 5th semester or higher is essential

  • Interest in at least one of the following fields: data analytics, machine learning, computer vision

  • Experience with Python and PyTorch is required. Experience with ROS2 and/or LiDAR is a plus

  • Proficiency in English

  • Willingness to learn and quickly adapt to new research topics

  • Self-motivation and hands-on attitude

  • Ability to think conceptually and express ideas clearly and convincingly

  • Availability for six months (start and end dates are open for discussion)

Application Details:

Non-EU/EFTA citizens, please note that a certificate from your university, showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies, is required for the visa application.

More about us

Electrification provides leading electrical distribution and management technologies, solutions and services to electrify the world in a safe, smart and sustainable way. The portfolio includes medium- and low-voltage electrical components, switchgear, digital devices, enclosures, and circuit breakers, among others. With our products, solutions and services, we collaborate with customers to improve power delivery and security, enhance energy management, efficiency and operational reliability, as we seek to achieve a low carbon society. go.abb/electrification

We look forward to receiving your application.

The recruiting process is being led by Mara Werne, Talent Partner at ABB Switzerland, Ltd.

jobs.title: Internship - strategischer Einkauf (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Procurement Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to gain vocational experience through a temporary work placement. Each day, you will acquire knowledge by performing tasks as directed. You will also showcase your skills by supporting ABB’s operations and enhancing personal education/employment opportunities

The work model for the role is: #LI-onsite

This role is contributing to Procurement team in Schaffhausen, Switzerland. Main stakeholders are Electrification Division.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Manage sub projects in sourcing and benchmarking activities
  • Support the local Power User with our eProcurement tools
  • Assist and support in process optimization
  • Report on price development and market intelligence
  • Master Data correction actions & document management
  • External supplier correspondence and KPI tracking and reporting
  • Organize and prepare supplier visits and audits

• Qualifications for the role

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor or Master degree in economics, engineering, information systems or similar with first supply chain experience
  • Fluent in German and English
  • Confidential handling of MS Excel
  • Good communication skills; shows initiative, self-managing, and well-organized working behavior
  • Curiosity and initiative
  • SAP knowledge is a plus
  • You hold a current valid VISA/work permit for Switzerland or a confirmation for a mandatory internship from your university

More about us

ABB Smart Buildings enables optimization of energy efficiency, safety, security and comfort for any building type, through new installations or retrofit solutions. The Division offers integrated digital technologies to control HVAC, lighting, shutters, and security, in addition to energy distribution solutions including DIN rail products, enclosures and emergency lighting through to industrial plugs and sockets and conventional wiring accessories, accommodating for single family homes, multiple dwellings, commercial buildings, infrastructure and industrial applications. The Division’s highly innovative technologies and digital solutions serve rising global demand among real estate developers, owners, and investors for smart building technologies that optimize energy distribution and building automation. The scalable solutions aim to deliver significant sustainable and financial benefits, meeting social and environmental demands, while being able to address even the most complex of customers’ carbon reduction strategies.

We look forward to receiving your application. The recruiting process is led by Talent Partner Mara Werne. If you would like to learn more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder Mensch hier macht das möglich. Sie werden in der Lage sein zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie, das zu führen, was die Welt regiert. Diese Position berichtet an: Procurement Manager Ihre Rolle und Verantwortlichkeiten In dieser Funktion haben Sie die Möglichkeit, durch ein befristetes Praktikum Berufserfahrung zu sammeln. Jeden Tag erwerben Sie Wissen, indem Sie Aufgaben wie angewiesen ausführen. Sie werden auch Ihre Fähigkeiten präsentieren, indem Sie die Aktivitäten von ABB unterstützen und persönliche Bildungs- / Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten verbessern Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle ist: #LI-onsite Diese Rolle trägt zum Beschaffungsteam in Schaffhausen, Schweiz, bei. Hauptakteure sind die Electrification Division. Sie sind hauptsächlich verantwortlich für: - Verwalten von Teilprojekten in Sourcing- und Benchmarking-Aktivitäten - Unterstützen Sie den lokalen Power User mit unseren eProcurement-Tools - Unterstützen und Unterstützen bei der Prozessoptimierung - Bericht über Preisentwicklung und Marktintelligenz - Master Data Correction Actions & Document Management - Externe Lieferantenkorrespondenz und KPI-Tracking und Reporting - Organisieren und Vorbereiten von Lieferantenbesuchen und Audits
• Qualifikationen für die Rolle - Derzeit verfolgen Sie einen Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Wirtschaft, Ingenieurwesen, Informationssystemen oder ähnlichem mit erster Supply Chain Erfahrung - Fließend in Deutsch und Englisch - Vertraulicher Umgang mit MS Excel - Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten; zeigt Initiative, Selbstmanagement und gut organisiertes Arbeitsverhalten - Neugier und Initiative - SAP-Wissen ist ein Plus - Sie besitzen eine gültige VISA/Arbeitserlaubnis für die Schweiz oder eine Bestätigung für ein Pflichtpraktikum Ihrer Universität Mehr über uns ABB Smart Buildings ermöglicht die Optimierung von Energieeffizienz, Sicherheit und Komfort für jeden Gebäudetyp durch neue Installationen oder Nachrüstlösungen. Die Division bietet integrierte digitale Technologien zur Steuerung von HVAC, Beleuchtung, Rollläden und Sicherheit, zusätzlich zu Energieverteilungslösungen wie DIN-Schienenprodukten, Gehäusen und Notbeleuchtung bis hin zu industriellen Steckern und Steckdosen und herkömmlichem Verkabelungszubehör, Unterbringung für Einfamilienhäuser, Mehrfamilienhäuser, Geschäftsgebäude, Infrastruktur und industrielle Anwendungen. Die hochinnovativen Technologien und digitalen Lösungen der Division bedienen die weltweit steigende Nachfrage von Immobilienentwicklern, Eigentümern und Investoren nach intelligenten Gebäudetechnologien, die die Energieverteilung und Gebäudeautomation optimieren. Die skalierbaren Lösungen zielen darauf ab, erhebliche nachhaltige und finanzielle Vorteile zu bieten, soziale und ökologische Anforderungen zu erfüllen und gleichzeitig selbst die komplexesten Strategien der Kunden zur CO2-Reduktion zu bewältigen. jobs.title: R&D (Senior) Scientist - Medium Voltage High Power Magnetics
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Team Lead

__


Your role and responsibilities

The mission of this team is to bring modern and disruptive power electronic solutions from research into product development. We improve our products by holistic optimization, pushing forward novel converter topologies as well as optimizing key components. By joining us, you will participate in idea generation at the frontier of academic research and industrial applications, as well as in the development of advanced technologies for ABB’s products.

Do you want to contribute to a greener future by utilizing advanced and highly efficient power-electronic solutions for various applications? Get in touch with us! A young, multinational team is looking forward to welcoming you as their latest team member!

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

The main responsibilities include

  • Develop low- to medium-frequency, high-power magnetic components with medium-voltage insulation for emerging power electronics applications.
  • Generate innovative concepts at the intersection of power electronics and magnetics.
  • Plan, set up, and execute experimental characterization, including model validation of magnetic components.
  • Contribute your expertise to research projects and translate results into patent applications, scientific publications, and technical reports.
  • Build and maintain a professional network within the organization, actively sharing knowledge and fostering collaboration.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Ph.D. in electrical engineering, power electronics, physics, or a related field.
  • Excellent scientific publication record in high-impact journals and leading power electronics conferences.
  • Expertise in designing medium-frequency transformers with medium-voltage insulation.
  • Experience with magnetic core materials and winding technologies (e.g., Litz wire, foil) across low to high frequency ranges.
  • Strong modeling capabilities for magnetic components, including electromagnetic simulations and thermal management.
  • Proven hands-on laboratory experience in testing and characterization, with a solid foundation in power electronics and fluency in English (written and spoken).

More about us

At the ABB research center in Baden-Dättwil in the proximity of Zurich, we work on exciting technologies that shape the future of our products. Our international research teams focus on Power Electronics, Energy Storage, Intelligent Systems, and Switching.

We look forward to receiving your application.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

IS Service Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities
In this role, you will have the opportunity to own software solution architecture across multiple architecture categories and ensure its alignment with enterprise and data architecture standards. Each day, you will be responsible for the design and build, integrity, and quality of an Information Systems (IS) solution and associated IS services delivered to business. You will also showcase your expertise by consulting, advising, and supporting on the installation of new IS solutions/services, or changing existing IS solutions/services.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Ensuring that the IS solutions/services provide the required functionality, meet the expectations of business and are reliable, maintainable, compliant, and auditable.

  • Approving, signing-off, and building any solution to be implemented on ABB production environment, within the respective service line, ensuring required quality and safety standards.

  • Contributing to IS problem and incident management by identifying and eliminating the reoccurring defects.

  • Defining the technical IS solution and ensuring alignment with other modules and surrounding IS applications through cooperation and collaboration among IS solution architects and IS delivery units.


• Qualifications for the role

  • Completed apprenticeship (EFZ) or equivalent qualification

  • Good communication skills in German and English (both written and spoken)

  • First professional experience is a plus (internship or entry-level experience)

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

  • Ability to work independently as well as part of a team

  • Basic knowledge of MS Office (e.g., Outlook, Excel, Teams)

jobs.title: Intern Treasury Technology
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

IS Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

ABB’s Corporate Treasury department in Zurich is the backbone of the ABB Group’s worldwide financial infrastructure, managing and executing financial transaction for the Group (debt capital markets, cash management etc.), acting as an inhouse-bank within the ABB Group and supporting ABB’s business with various financial services and products (incl. Foreign Currency and Commodity Hedging, Export and Trade Finance solutions, etc.). The department owns and is supported by several key IT systems/solutions, including among others a Treasury Management System, Guarantee Management System as well as centralized Cash Management Solution.

We are looking for a treasury technology intern (80-100%) to join our team. This internship offers a valuable chance for you to acquire professional experience within the Treasury department of a large multinational corporation during a temporary placement lasting from 12 months to a maximum of 18 months.

As part of our collaborative team, you will be contributing your skills across a myriad of technical areas, including:

  • leading requirements gathering on the project demand list
  • building a unified data model to transform raw data from multiple underlying Treasury solutions into clean usable datasets for reporting and analytics
  • supporting the building of a corporate Snowflake instance for Treasury specific data
  • supporting implementation work on ongoing technology implementations
  • providing insight training to Treasury employees on technology topics, such as AI


Additionally, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with the Treasury Global Process Owner and Middle Office Team, as well as each of the Treasury Workstreams (incl. e.g. internal controls, data cleansing and report generation, etc.).

• Qualifications for the role

We are looking for applicants who possess the following qualifications, reflecting their academic and potential for growth:

  • You will soon finish or have finished your bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Information Technology, preferable with a specialization in data science/analysis, within the next/past 12 months
  • You are interested in discovering more about financial transactions, finance processes and related data consumed and produced by a large multinational in the Treasury space
  • You have experience in data modelling, database design, data analysis, requirements engineering and have worked with systems/solutions to enable this (SQL, ADF, Snowflake)
  • Any experience in working with Power BI, Treasury Management Systems (ION Wallstreet), SAP and other Treasury applications, is a plus.
  • You demonstrate analytical and organizational skills, are a quick and efficient learner, and build strong relationships within teams
  • You are based in Zurich and hold a current valid VISA/work permit for Switzerland or a confirmation for a mandatory internship from your university
  • You are proficient in English and have effective communication skills

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Project Operations Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will be responsible for the operational execution of medium-size customer projects within the Medium Voltage Switchgear business, from order handover through delivery and close-out. You will ensure disciplined project execution in line with contractual requirements, internal processes, and quality standards. Acting as the central coordination point, you will closely interface international factories, engineering, production, logistics, and local stakeholders to ensure reliable delivery, cost control, and customer satisfaction.

The work model for the role is: hybrid #LI-hybrid

This role is contributing to the Medium Voltage Switchgear business within the Electrification Distribution Solutions division in Switzerland.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Owning end-to-end project execution towards the customer, coordinating with factory-based project managers, engineering, production, and logistics to deliver according to scope, schedule, cost, and quality commitments.
  • Actively driving detailed planning, progress tracking, expediting, and interface management, with a strong focus on delivery reliability, issue resolution, and adherence to milestones.
  • Managing project financials, risks, changes, and claims in close alignment with internal stakeholders, ensuring early identification of deviations and implementation of corrective actions.
  • Leading project close-out activities, including customer acceptance, documentation completeness, and the structured capture, evaluation, and implementation of lessons learned to continuously improve project execution.

• Qualifications for the role:

  • You hold a degree in Electrical Engineering or a related engineering field, or a higher professional education qualification in engineering (e.g. Höhere Fachschule), with strong relevance to electrical products and systems.
  • You have several years of hands-on experience managing or coordinating industrial customer projects, ideally within medium voltage switchgear, or complex engineered products.
  • You have solid practical experience applying project management methodologies (e.g. IPMA, PMP, or equivalent) in an operational, delivery-focused environment.
  • You are highly proficient in project execution tools, including MS Office, MS Project, SharePoint, Teams, and SAP, and use them actively to drive transparency and control.
  • You are confident working with international factories and cross-functional teams, with strong skills in interface management, expediting, and problem solving.
  • You bring sound knowledge of contracts, change management, and claim handling, and are comfortable addressing deviations with internal and external stakeholders.
  • You communicate fluently in German and English (minimum C1 level in both), demonstrate a pragmatic, resilient mindset, and are comfortable operating in a fast-paced, execution-driven environment.

More about us

ABB's Distribution Solutions division provides medium voltage components, switchgear, and solutions that connect and protect the evolving electrical grid, ensuring reliable and predictable energy distribution. We link high-voltage systems to medium and low-voltage consumers, ensuring continuous power delivery to industrial, commercial, and residential users while enabling the integration of renewable energy sources into the grid. Our smart solutions, powered by AI, enhance grid resilience and optimize the usage of the electrical system.


With ABB Ability™ enabled connected solutions, the offering includes medium-voltage air- and gas-insulated switchgear (1 to 46 kilovolts), indoor and outdoor circuit breakers, protection relays, instrument transformers, sensors and solutions for distribution stations.


We support our customers and partners in staying ahead of increasing electrification needs, technology, and regulatory changes, providing the power to adapt to a rapidly evolving energy landscape.

We look forward to receiving your application (documents submitted in English are appreciated). The recruiting process is being led by Reto Korstick, Talent Partner at ABB Switzerland Ltd. If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

• Qualifiche per il ruolo: - Hai una laurea in Ingegneria Elettrica o in un campo di ingegneria correlato, o una qualifica di istruzione professionale superiore in ingegneria (ad esempio Höhere Fachschule), con forte rilevanza per i prodotti e sistemi elettrici. - No. Hai diversi anni di esperienza di gestione o coordinamento di progetti di clienti industriali, idealmente all'interno di switchgear di media tensione, o prodotti ingegnerizzati complessi. - No. Hai una solida esperienza pratica nell'applicazione di metodologie di gestione del progetto (ad esempio IPMA, PMP o equivalente) in un ambiente operativo, orientato alla consegna. - No. Siete altamente competenti negli strumenti di esecuzione del progetto, tra cui MS Office, MS Project, SharePoint, Teams e SAP, e utilizzarli attivamente per guidare la trasparenza e il controllo. - No. Sei sicuro di lavorare con fabbriche internazionali e team interfunzionali, con forti competenze nella gestione delle interfacce, expediting e problem solving. - No. Porti una solida conoscenza dei contratti, della gestione dei cambiamenti e della gestione dei reclami, e stai affrontando le deviazioni con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni. - Si comunica fluentemente in tedesco e in inglese (minimo livello C1 in entrambi), dimostrare una mentalità pragmatica e resiliente, e sono confortevoli che operano in un ambiente veloce e guidato dall'esecuzione. Vous serez principalement responsable de : - Posséder l'exécution de bout en bout du projet vers le client, la coordination avec les gestionnaires de projet en usine, l'ingénierie, la production, et la logistique à livrer selon la portée, le calendrier, les coûts et les engagements de qualité. - Diriger activement la planification détaillée, le suivi des progrès, l'accélération et la gestion de l'interface, en mettant fortement l'accent sur la fiabilité de la livraison, la résolution des problèmes et le respect des jalons. - Gérer les finances, les risques, les changements et les réclamations en étroite harmonie avec les intervenants internes, en veillant à identifier rapidement les écarts et à mettre en oeuvre des mesures correctives. - Diriger les activités de clôture des projets, y compris l'acceptation des clients, l'exhaustivité de la documentation et la saisie structurée, l'évaluation et la mise en oeuvre des leçons apprises pour améliorer continuellement l'exécution des projets.

Vous êtes confiant en travaillant avec des usines internationales et des équipes interfonctionnelles, avec de solides compétences en gestion des interfaces, en accélération et en résolution de problèmes. - Oui. Vous apportez une bonne connaissance des contrats, de la gestion du changement et du traitement des réclamations, et vous êtes à l'aise avec les intervenants internes et externes. - Vous communiquez couramment en allemand et en anglais (niveau minimum C1 dans les deux), démontrez un état d'esprit pragmatique et résilient, et êtes à l'aise de fonctionner dans un environnement rapide et axé sur l'exécution. En savoir plus sur nous La division Distribution Solutions d'ABB fournit des composants à moyenne tension, des commutateurs et des solutions qui relient et protègent le réseau électrique en évolution, assurant une distribution d'énergie fiable et prévisible. Nous lions les systèmes à haute tension aux consommateurs à moyenne et basse tension, assurant une distribution continue d'énergie aux utilisateurs industriels, commerciaux et résidentiels tout en permettant l'intégration des sources d'énergie renouvelables dans le réseau. Nos solutions intelligentes, alimentées par l'IA, améliorent la résilience du réseau et optimisent l'utilisation du système électrique. Nous aidons nos clients et partenaires à rester en avance sur les besoins croissants en électrification, la technologie et les changements réglementaires, fournissant ainsi le pouvoir de s'adapter à un paysage énergétique en évolution rapide. jobs.title: Technical Product Owner Service MV Drives (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Head of R&D and Life Cycle Management


Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will oversee the global manufacturability, quality, and cost optimization of service products within your scope, with focus on LCI. You will play a key role in shaping product development by aligning with product managers on roadmap execution, defining and prioritizing tasks that reflect business needs. Your technical skills, combined with close collaboration across Motion Service and Motion High Power teams, will be essential in advancing solutions.

As a technical partner, you will act as the primary contact for market-facing product management and other stakeholders such as engineering and operations, supporting them on product-related topics and ensuring smooth coordination across functions.


The work model for the role is: hybrid #LI-hybrid


This role is contributing to the Business Line Medium Voltage Drives in Motion Service.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Managing and prioritizing product-related tasks, ensuring smooth execution and delivery. This includes gathering input from various teams, making decisions on minor topics, consulting stakeholders for complex ones, and maintaining all relevant documentation.
  • Overseeing the product lifecycle in alignment with strategic goals, including proactive obsolescence management, assessing the impact of standard changes, and maintaining service-specific tools in collaboration with compliance and portfolio teams.
  • Contributing to service R&D projects and support the transition of service products through their release phases. You’ll also help evaluate engineered solutions and collaborate with product management to decide when to productize.
  • Supporting sales and operations by clarifying technical questions, assisting with technical solution agreements (TSAs), and reviewing complex engineered solutions to ensure they align with product strategy and customer needs.


• Qualifications for the role

  • You have a degree in electrical or power engineering, or a similar field such as mechanical engineering (M.Sc. or B.Sc.), and enjoy applying your knowledge in industrial settings.
  • You have 5+ years of experience in the industrial sector, within the power energy field, and 2-3 years of experience in functionally leading small engineering teams.
  • You are highly skilled in ABB products, supported by internal training, and possess an understanding of product lifecycle and documentation processes.
  • You are motivated by collaboration and communication, a team player who is well-organized, with a high sense of responsibility, and a commitment to safety and integrity.
  • You are fluent in English, and communicating effectively in a multicultural environment; German language skills are a plus.


More about us

ABB Motion Service Division serves customers worldwide by maximizing uptime, extending product life cycle and enhancing the performance and energy efficiency of their electrical motion solutions. The Division is advancing digitalization by securely connecting motors and drives, increasing operational uptime and improving efficiency. The services offered make the difference for our customers and partners every day by helping keep their operations running profitably, safely and reliably.

We look forward to receiving your application (documents submitted in English are appreciated). The recruiting process is being led by Azra Filan, Talent Partner at ABB Switzerland Ltd. If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.

jobs.title: Bid & Proposal Engineer - Medium Voltage Products and Solutions
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

EL Sales Supp. Mgr.-Configur.&Quotation

__

Votre rôle et vos responsabilités

Dans ce poste de Bid & Proposal Engineer – Distribution moyenne tension Products and Solutions - vous jouez un rôle central dans le processus commercial des solutions moyenne tension. Vous collaborez étroitement avec les équipes de vente, nos fournisseurs et nos clients tout au long des phases de consultation et d’appel d’offres.
Vous contribuez directement à la qualité et à la compétitivité de nos offres en combinant expertise technique, sens commercial et rigueur d’exécution.

Le modèle de travail pour ce rôle est: hybride.
Ce rôle contribue activement au développement de la base installée moyenne tension chez nos clients au sein de la division Distribution Solutions – ABB Electrification Suisse.

Vos principales responsabilités

  • Coordonner les demandes d’offres et assurer le respect des délais tout au long du processus d’appel d’offres

  • Analyser les cahiers des charges, spécifications techniques et exigences clients sous les angles technique et commercial, et sélectionner les solutions et produits les plus adaptés en fonction des besoins clients et du portefeuille de solutions

  • Définir les stratégies d’offre en collaboration avec les équipes commerciales, d’ingénierie et de gestion de projet, et mener les négociations avec les fournisseurs durant la phase d’offre

  • Réaliser les calculs des coûts et structurer la documentation technique et commerciale des offres (descriptions produits, services, livrables)

• Votre profil

  • Vous êtes titulaire d’un diplôme en génie électrique ou d’une formation équivalente (HES, école d’ingénieurs ou formation technique supérieure)

  • Expérience confirmée en environnement technique industriel, idéalement dans la gestion d’offres ou de projets

  • Vous faites preuve d’autonomie, de flexibilité et d’une forte orientation client

  • Excellentes compétences en communication en français et en anglais (l’allemand est un atout)

  • Vous êtes passionné(e) par l’analyse et la sélection de stratégies commerciales et de solutions en fonction des besoins clients

  • Bonne maîtrise des calculs de coûts et de la structuration d’offres techniques

  • Vous possédez un esprit d’équipe, de la fiabilité et une grande intégrité professionnelle



    Your role and responsibilities

    In this role, you will have the opportunity to support the assigned Sales organization (division and market) and customers during the proposal process. Each day, you will serve as a key technical resource in the assigned area. You will also showcase your expertise by preparing technical descriptions of the products and technology, determining costs, and preparing final documentation.
    The work model for the role is: hybrid.
    This role is contributing to the Medium Voltage Switchgear business within the Electrification Distribution Solutions division in Switzerland.

    You will be mainly accountable for

    • Coordinating quote requests and deadlines as well as conducting procurement negotiations with suppliers during the tendering phase

    • Analyzing and evaluating requests, specifications and tenders from technical and commercial perspectives

    • Defining sales strategies and designing product configurations based on customer requirements in collaboration with sales, engineering and project management

    • Creating commercial and technical quote documentation, including detailed description of products and services

    • Qualifications for the role

    • You hold a degree in Electrical Engineering or a related engineering field, or a higher professional qualification in engineering (e.g. Höhere Fachschule, Fachhochschule)

    • You are captivated by independent, flexible and customer-oriented working style

    • You are at ease communicating in French and English (German is an advantage)

    • You are passionate about finding the right sales strategies and products based on customer needs

    • Proven experience of cost calculations

    • You are a reliable team player and personality with integrity

​More about us

ABB's Distribution Solutions division provides medium voltage components, switchgear, and solutions that connect and protect the evolving electrical grid, ensuring reliable and predictable energy distribution. We link high-voltage systems to medium and low-voltage consumers, ensuring continuous power delivery to industrial, commercial, and residential users while enabling the integration of renewable energy sources into the grid. Our smart solutions, powered by AI, enhance grid resilience and optimize the usage of the electrical system.

With ABB Ability™ enabled connected solutions, the offering includes medium-voltage air- and gas-insulated switchgear (1 to 46 kilovolts), indoor and outdoor circuit breakers, protection relays, instrument transformers, sensors and solutions for distribution stations. We support our customers and partners in staying ahead of increasing electrification needs, technology, and regulatory changes, providing the power to adapt to a rapidly evolving energy landscape.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Collegamo sistemi ad alta tensione a consumatori di media e bassa tensione, garantendo una fornitura continua di energia agli utenti industriali, commerciali e residenziali, consentendo l'integrazione di fonti energetiche rinnovabili nella rete. Le nostre soluzioni intelligenti, alimentate da AI, migliorano la resilienza della griglia e ottimizzano l'utilizzo del sistema elettrico. Grazie alle soluzioni connesse abilitate ABB AbilityTM, l'offerta include interruttori isolati ad aria e gas ad alta tensione (da 1 a 46 chilogrammi), interruttori a circuito chiuso ed esterno, relè di protezione, trasformatori di strumenti, sensori e soluzioni per stazioni di distribuzione. Sosteniamo i nostri clienti e partner a rimanere in vista di crescenti esigenze di elettrificazione, tecnologia e cambiamenti normativi, fornendo il potere di adattarsi a un panorama energetico in rapida evoluzione. Costruire un futuro più pulito e intelligente prende tutti i tipi di menti: i curiosi, i coraggiosi e i creativi. Ecco perché accogliamo le persone da tutti gli sfondi e le esperienze. descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. This position reports to: EL Sales Supp. Mgr.-Configur.&Quotation __ Votre rôle et vos responsabilités Dans ce poste de Bid & Proposal Engineer – Distribution moyenne tension Products and Solutions - vous jouez un rôle central dans le processus commercial des solutions moyenne tension. Vous collaborez étroitement avec les équipes de vente, nos fournisseurs et nos clients tout au long des phases de consultation et d’appel d’offres. Vous contribuez directement à la qualité et à la compétitivité de nos offres en combinant expertise technique, sens commercial et rigueur d’exécution. Le modèle de travail pour ce rôle est: hybride. Ce rôle contribue activement au développement de la base installée moyenne tension chez nos clients au sein de la division Distribution Solutions – ABB Electrification Suisse. Vos principales responsabilités - Coordonner les demandes d’offres et assurer le respect des délais tout au long du processus d’appel d’offres - Analyser les cahiers des charges, spécifications techniques et exigences clients sous les angles technique et commercial, et sélectionner les solutions et produits les plus adaptés en fonction des besoins clients et du portefeuille de solutions - Définir les stratégies d’offre en collaboration avec les équipes commerciales, d’ingénierie et de gestion de projet, et mener les négociations avec les fournisseurs durant la phase d’offre - Réaliser les calculs des coûts et structurer la documentation technique et commerciale des offres (descriptions produits, services, livrables)
• Votre profil - Vous êtes titulaire d’un diplôme en génie électrique ou d’une formation équivalente (HES, école d’ingénieurs ou formation technique supérieure) - Expérience confirmée en environnement technique industriel, idéalement dans la gestion d’offres ou de projets - Vous faites preuve d’autonomie, de flexibilité et d’une forte orientation client - Excellentes compétences en communication en français et en anglais (l’allemand est un atout) - Vous êtes passionné(e) par l’analyse et la sélection de stratégies commerciales et de solutions en fonction des besoins clients - Bonne maîtrise des calculs de coûts et de la structuration d’offres techniques - Vous possédez un esprit d’équipe, de la fiabilité et une grande intégrité professionnelle Your role and responsibilities In this role, you will have the opportunity to support the assigned Sales organization (division and market) and customers during the proposal process. Each day, you will serve as a key technical resource in the assigned area. You will also showcase your expertise by preparing technical descriptions of the products and technology, determining costs, and preparing final documentation. The work model for the role is: hybrid. This role is contributing to the Medium Voltage Switchgear business within the Electrification Distribution Solutions division in Switzerland. You will be mainly accountable for - Coordinating quote requests and deadlines as well as conducting procurement negotiations with suppliers during the tendering phase - Analyzing and evaluating requests, specifications and tenders from technical and commercial perspectives - Defining sales strategies and designing product configurations based on customer requirements in collaboration with sales, engineering and project management - Creating commercial and technical quote documentation, including detailed description of products and services
• Qualifications for the role - You hold a degree in Electrical Engineering or a related engineering field, or a higher professional qualification in engineering (e.g. Höhere Fachschule, Fachhochschule) - You are captivated by independent, flexible and customer-oriented working style - You are at ease communicating in French and English (German is an advantage) - You are passionate about finding the right sales strategies and products based on customer needs - Proven experience of cost calculations - You are a reliable team player and personality with integrity ​ More about us ABB's Distribution Solutions division provides medium voltage components, switchgear, and solutions that connect and protect the evolving electrical grid, ensuring reliable and predictable energy distribution. We link high-voltage systems to medium and low-voltage consumers, ensuring continuous power delivery to industrial, commercial, and residential users while enabling the integration of renewable energy sources into the grid. Our smart solutions, powered by AI, enhance grid resilience and optimize the usage of the electrical system. With ABB Ability™ enabled connected solutions, the offering includes medium-voltage air- and gas-insulated switchgear (1 to 46 kilovolts), indoor and outdoor circuit breakers, protection relays, instrument transformers, sensors and solutions for distribution stations. We support our customers and partners in staying ahead of increasing electrification needs, technology, and regulatory changes, providing the power to adapt to a rapidly evolving energy landscape. Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences. Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Jeden Tag werden Sie als eine wichtige technische Ressource in dem zugewiesenen Bereich dienen. • Qualifikationen für die Rolle - Sie haben einen Abschluss in Elektrotechnik oder einem verwandten Ingenieurbereich oder eine höhere berufliche Qualifikation im Ingenieurwesen (z. B. Höhere Fachschule, Fachhochschule) - Sie sind fasziniert von unabhängigem, flexiblem und kundenorientiertem Arbeitsstil - Sie sind bequem in Französisch und Englisch (Deutsch ist ein Vorteil) - Sie sind leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, die richtigen Verkaufsstrategien und Produkte zu finden, die auf den Kundenbedürfnissen basieren - Nachgewiesene Erfahrung mit Kostenberechnungen - Sie sind ein zuverlässiger Teamplayer und eine Persönlichkeit mit Integrität Mehr über uns Die Distribution Solutions Division von ABB bietet Mittelspannungskomponenten, Schaltanlagen und Lösungen, die das sich entwickelnde Stromnetz verbinden und schützen und eine zuverlässige und vorhersehbare Energieverteilung gewährleisten. Wir verbinden Hochspannungssysteme mit Mittel- und Niederspannungsverbrauchern und gewährleisten eine kontinuierliche Stromversorgung für Industrie-, Gewerbe- und Privatanwender und ermöglichen gleichzeitig die Integration erneuerbarer Energiequellen in das Netz. Unsere intelligenten Lösungen, powered by AI, verbessern die Netzresistenz und optimieren die Nutzung des elektrischen Systems. Mit ABB AbilityTM-fähigen vernetzten Lösungen umfasst das Angebot Mittelspannungs-luft- und gasisolierte Schaltanlagen (1 bis 46 Kilovolt), Innen- und Außenleistungsschalter, Schutzrelais, Messwandler, Sensoren und Lösungen für Verteilerstationen. Wir unterstützen unsere Kunden und Partner dabei, dem steigenden Elektrifizierungsbedarf, der Technologie und den regulatorischen Änderungen immer einen Schritt voraus zu sein und bieten die Möglichkeit, sich an eine sich schnell entwickelnde Energielandschaft anzupassen. Der Aufbau einer saubereren, intelligenteren Zukunft erfordert alle Arten von Köpfen: das Neugierige, das Mutige und das Kreative. Deshalb begrüßen wir Menschen mit allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen. Bereit, eine Wirkung zu erzielen? Bewerben Sie sich noch heute oder besuchen Sie https://www.abb.com, um mehr über die Auswirkungen unserer Lösungen auf der ganzen Welt zu erfahren.
