jobs.title: Design Engineer
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Engineering Manager

__

Ihre Rolle und Verantwortung:

In dieser Rolle haben Sie die Möglichkeit, das Design von Geräten, Systemen oder Installationen zu erstellen oder vorgefertigte Entwürfe für • Aufgaben durch Anwendung von Standardkonzepten zu modifizieren. Jeden Tag helfen Sie bei der Planung von technischen Lösungen, einschließlich Zeichnungen und Berechnungen nach Vorschriften. Sie zeigen Ihr Fachwissen außerdem, indem Sie an Designprüfungen, Designverifikationen teilnehmen und das Design bei Bedarf anpassen.

Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle ist: hybrid.

Diese Rolle trägt zum PMA-Geschäft bei.

Sie werden hauptsächlich verantwortlich sein für:

  • Unterstützt bei der Entwicklung von Kabelschutzprodukten und -systemen, die in Strom- und Datenanwendungen eingesetzt werden.

  • Trägt zu Produktentwicklungsprojekten von der Konzeptphase bis zur Erstartikelprüfung bei.

  • Unterstützt die Prüfung und Qualifikation der Teile.

  • Erstellt und pflegt Designdokumentation und Datenmanagement.


Unsere Teamdynamik Sie werden Teil eines dynamischen Teams, in dem Sie erfolgreich sein können.

Qualifikationen für die Rolle

  • Absolvierte eine Lehre als Konstrukteur bei EFZ.

  • Fundiertes Wissen und praktische Erfahrung im Produktdesign und 3D-CAD (vorzugsweise PTC Creo).

  • Erfahren in MS Office-Anwendungen, Windchill und SAP.

  • Hohe Motivation und Engagement, um eine Karriere am ABB zu bewältigen.

  • Fließend Deutsch und gute Englischkenntnisse.

  • Sie sind entweder Schweizer Staatsbürger oder haben eine gültige Aufenthaltserlaubnis für die Schweiz.

Mehr über uns


Wir entwickeln Kabelschutzsysteme für unsere globalen Kunden in einer Vielzahl von Marktsegmenten. Unser Ziel ist es, unsere Position in unseren Zielmärkten durch gezielte Entwicklung und Verbesserung unserer Lösungen zu stärken.

Wir freuen uns darauf, Ihre Bewerbung zu erhalten. Der Rekrutierungsprozess wird von Reto Korstick, Talentpartner ABB Schweiz AG, geleitet. Wenn Sie mehr über ABB erfahren möchten, schauen Sie sich unsere Website an www.abb.com

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Diese Rolle trägt zum PMA-Geschäft bei.

  • Absolvierte eine Lehre als Konstrukteur bei EFZ.

jobs.title: R&D Senior Engineer
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Manager Critical Power

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute your creativity and technical knowledge to the development of new and innovative solutions. You will be responsible for product development in the field of high-performance miniature circuit breakers, including conducting preliminary studies, planning, evaluating and developing key product features that require broad technical knowledge


The working model for the role is: onsite

They are mainly responsible for:

  • Coordinate tasks involving employees from other departments to investigate problems, develop solutions, and make recommendations in the role of senior engineer or project manager

  • Analysis of technical and economic aspects of proposed solutions to support decision-making

  • Proactively identify and execute tasks to improve operations, reduce costs, and increase customer satisfaction

  • Developing, planning, implementing and coordinating recommendations for studies to promote innovation

  • Representation of the organization at international meetings; Interact with customers to resolve key technical issues and develop appropriate action plans

  • This position reports to the R&D Platform Owner High Performance MCB's

• Qualifications for the role

  • Bachelor's or master’s degree in electrical engineering/Mechatronics or a related field

  • At least 5 years of experience as a development engineer or design engineer

  • Strong technical knowledge in the following areas:

  • Mechanical and electrical systems of low-voltage products

  • Design of mechanical and electrical interfaces

  • Construction of plastic and metal parts

  • Manual and automated assembly processes for components in low-voltage technology

  • Good understanding of project management methodologies with proven experience

  • Good knowledge of the use of CAD software, preferably Solidworks

  • Strong written and spoken communication skills (German and English)

  • Experience working with global suppliers, manufacturing and engineering resources

More about us

ABB Smart Buildings digitizes commercial, industrial and residential buildings for the highest levels of comfort, efficiency, safety and protection – and increases the quality of life in buildings of the future through safe, intelligent and sustainable electrification solutions, services and products.

We look forward to receiving your application! The recruitment process is led by Reto Korstick, Talent Partner ABB Switzerland. To learn more about ABB, visit our website at www.abb.com.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Questa posizione riporta a:
R&D Manager Critical Power

Non lo so.

Il vostro ruolo e responsabilità

In questo ruolo, avrete l'opportunità di contribuire alla vostra creatività e conoscenza tecnica allo sviluppo di nuove e innovative soluzioni. Sarete responsabili per lo sviluppo del prodotto nel campo degli interruttori miniaturizzati ad alte prestazioni, tra cui condurre studi preliminari, pianificazione, valutazione e sviluppo di caratteristiche chiave del prodotto che richiedono una vasta conoscenza tecnica

Il modello di lavoro per il ruolo è: onsite

Sono principalmente responsabili di:

- No.
Coordinare i compiti che coinvolgono i dipendenti di altri dipartimenti per indagare i problemi, sviluppare soluzioni e formulare raccomandazioni nel ruolo di senior engineer o project manager

- No.
Analisi degli aspetti tecnici ed economici delle soluzioni proposte per sostenere il processo decisionale

Identificare ed eseguire in modo attivo le attività per migliorare le operazioni, ridurre i costi e aumentare la soddisfazione del cliente

Sviluppo, pianificazione, attuazione e coordinamento delle raccomandazioni per gli studi volti a promuovere l'innovazione

Rappresentanza dell'organizzazione in incontri internazionali; Interagire con i clienti per risolvere questioni tecniche chiave e sviluppare piani d'azione adeguati

- No.

Corso di laurea o master in ingegneria elettrica / Meccatronica o un campo correlato

- No.
Almeno 5 anni di esperienza come ingegnere di sviluppo o ingegnere di progettazione

- No.
Sistemi meccanici ed elettrici di prodotti a bassa tensione

- No.
Progettazione di interfacce meccaniche ed elettriche

- No.
Costruzione di parti in plastica e metallo

- No.
Processi di montaggio manuali e automatizzati per componenti in tecnologia a bassa tensione

- No.
Buona comprensione delle metodologie di gestione del progetto con esperienza comprovata

- No.
Buona conoscenza dell'uso del software CAD, preferibilmente Solidworks

- No.
Forte capacità di comunicazione scritta e parlata (tedesco e inglese)

- No.
Esperienza di lavoro con fornitori globali, risorse produttive e ingegneristiche

ABB Smart Buildings digitalizza edifici commerciali, industriali e residenziali per i massimi livelli di comfort, efficienza, sicurezza e protezione e aumenta la qualità della vita negli edifici del futuro attraverso soluzioni di elettrificazione sicure, intelligenti e sostenibili.

Applicare o visitare https://www.abb.com per saperne di più sull'impatto delle nostre soluzioni in tutto il mondo.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder Mensch hier macht das möglich. Sie werden in der Lage sein zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie, das zu führen, was die Welt regiert. Diese Position berichtet an: R&D Manager Critical Power Ihre Rolle und Verantwortlichkeiten In dieser Rolle haben Sie die Möglichkeit, Ihre Kreativität und Ihr technisches Wissen in die Entwicklung neuer und innovativer Lösungen einzubringen. Sie sind für die Produktentwicklung im Bereich der leistungsstarken Miniatur-Leistungsschalter verantwortlich, einschließlich der Durchführung von Vorstudien, der Planung, Bewertung und Entwicklung wichtiger Produktmerkmale, die ein breites technisches Wissen erfordern Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle ist: vor Ort Sie sind hauptsächlich verantwortlich für: - Koordinierung von Aufgaben, an denen Mitarbeiter aus anderen Abteilungen beteiligt sind, um Probleme zu untersuchen, Lösungen zu entwickeln und Empfehlungen in der Rolle eines leitenden Ingenieurs oder Projektmanagers abzugeben - Analyse der technischen und wirtschaftlichen Aspekte der vorgeschlagenen Lösungen zur Unterstützung der Entscheidungsfindung - Proaktive Identifizierung und Ausführung von Aufgaben zur Verbesserung des Betriebs, Senkung der Kosten und Steigerung der Kundenzufriedenheit - Entwicklung, Planung, Umsetzung und Koordinierung von Empfehlungen für Studien zur Förderung der Innovation - Vertretung der Organisation bei internationalen Treffen; Interagieren Sie mit Kunden, um wichtige technische Probleme zu lösen und geeignete Aktionspläne zu entwickeln - Diese Position berichtet an den R & D Platform Owner High Performance MCB
• Qualifikationen für die Rolle - Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Elektrotechnik / Mechatronik oder einem verwandten Bereich - Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung als Entwicklungsingenieur oder Konstrukteur - Starke technische Kenntnisse in folgenden Bereichen: - Mechanische und elektrische Systeme von Niederspannungsprodukten - Design von mechanischen und elektrischen Schnittstellen - Bau von Kunststoff- und Metallteilen - Manuelle und automatisierte Montageprozesse für Komponenten in der Niederspannungstechnik - Gute Kenntnisse der Projektmanagement-Methoden mit nachgewiesener Erfahrung - Gute Kenntnisse des Einsatzes von CAD-Software, vorzugsweise Solidworks - Starke schriftliche und gesprochene Kommunikationsfähigkeiten (Deutsch und Englisch) - Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit globalen Lieferanten, Fertigungs- und Engineering-Ressourcen Mehr über uns ABB Smart Buildings digitalisiert Gewerbe-, Industrie- und Wohngebäude für höchste Komfort-, Effizienz-, Sicherheits- und Schutzniveaus - und erhöht die Lebensqualität in Gebäuden der Zukunft durch sichere, intelligente und nachhaltige Elektrifizierungslösungen, Dienstleistungen und Produkte. Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung! Den Rekrutierungsprozess leitet Reto Korstick, Talent Partner ABB Schweiz. Um mehr über ABB zu erfahren, besuchen Sie unsere Website unter www.abb.com. Der Aufbau einer saubereren, intelligenteren Zukunft erfordert alle Arten von Köpfen: das Neugierige, das Mutige und das Kreative. Deshalb begrüßen wir Menschen mit allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen. Bereit, eine Wirkung zu erzielen? Bewerben Sie sich noch heute oder besuchen Sie https://www.abb.com, um mehr über die Auswirkungen unserer Lösungen auf der ganzen Welt zu erfahren.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
A l'ABB, nous aidons les industries à fonctionner de façon plus propre, et chaque personne ici fait que cela arrive. Vous aurez le pouvoir de diriger, de soutenir la croissance et d'être fiers de l'impact que nous créons ensemble. Rejoignez-nous et aidez à gérer ce qui dirige le monde. Ce poste relève de : R&D Manager Critical Power Votre rôle et vos responsabilités Dans ce rôle, vous aurez l'occasion de contribuer à l'élaboration de solutions nouvelles et innovantes grâce à votre créativité et à vos connaissances techniques. Vous serez responsable du développement de produits dans le domaine des disjoncteurs miniatures haute performance, y compris la réalisation d'études préliminaires, la planification, l'évaluation et le développement de caractéristiques clés du produit qui nécessitent de vastes connaissances techniques Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est: Ils sont principalement responsables des tâches suivantes : - Coordonner les tâches impliquant des employés d'autres ministères pour étudier les problèmes, élaborer des solutions et formuler des recommandations dans le rôle d'ingénieur principal ou de gestionnaire de projet - Analyse des aspects techniques et économiques des solutions proposées pour appuyer la prise de décisions - Identifier et exécuter de façon proactive les tâches visant à améliorer les opérations, réduire les coûts et accroître la satisfaction de la clientèle - Élaborer, planifier, mettre en oeuvre et coordonner des recommandations pour des études visant à promouvoir l'innovation - Représentation de l'organisation aux réunions internationales; Interagir avec les clients pour résoudre les principaux problèmes techniques et élaborer des plans d'action appropriés - Ce poste relève du propriétaire de la plate-forme de R-D Haute performance MCB
• Qualifications pour le rôle - Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en génie électrique / Mécatronique ou un domaine connexe - Au moins 5 ans d'expérience en tant qu'ingénieur en développement ou ingénieur de conception - Fortes connaissances techniques dans les domaines suivants : - Systèmes mécaniques et électriques de produits à basse tension - Conception d'interfaces mécaniques et électriques - Construction de pièces en plastique et en métal - Procédés d'assemblage manuels et automatisés pour composants de technologies à basse tension - Bonne compréhension des méthodes de gestion de projet ayant une expérience éprouvée - Bonne connaissance de l'utilisation des logiciels CAO, de préférence Solidworks - Fortes compétences en communication écrite et orale (allemand et anglais) - Expérience de travail avec des fournisseurs mondiaux, des ressources de fabrication et d'ingénierie En savoir plus sur nous ABB Smart Buildings numérise les bâtiments commerciaux, industriels et résidentiels pour les plus hauts niveaux de confort, d'efficacité, de sécurité et de protection - et améliore la qualité de vie dans les bâtiments du futur grâce à des solutions, services et produits d'électrification sûrs, intelligents et durables. Nous sommes impatients de recevoir votre candidature! Le processus de recrutement est dirigé par Reto Korstick, Talent Partner ABB Suisse. Pour en savoir plus sur ABB, visitez notre site Web à www.abb.com. Construire un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent prend toutes sortes d'esprits : les curieux, les courageux et les créatifs. C'est pourquoi nous accueillons des gens de tous horizons et expériences. Prêt à avoir un impact ? Faites une demande aujourd'hui ou visitez https://www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur l'impact de nos solutions à travers le monde.

jobs.title: HR Business Partner
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

HUB BU HR Business Partner - EPIP Europe

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to develop and implement people strategy through the execution of HR processes. Each day, you will provide HR support for a defined team or location, by partnering with respective managers. You will also showcase your expertise by representing HR in the business and establishing strong relationships with all business leaders and employees.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

This role is contributing to the overall success of the ELIP Site in Uster. Main stakeholders are local site Management team and the European Leadership Team


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Supporting the business and the execution of HR processes involved across the end-to-end employee lifecycle

  • Determines and delivers the best approach in the area of responsibility and executes the HR priorities

  • Ensures effective communication, engagement, and collaboration across the organization

  • Facilitating change management initiatives and driving behavior change & continuous improvement across the respective business area / area of responsibility.

  • Supports the organization and the execution of HR processes involved across the end-to-end employee lifecycle

  • Leading and execution of HR initiatives and projects locally and work within the ELIP organization


Our team dynamics
You will join a dynamic, talented, high performing team, where you will be able to thrive.


• Qualifications for the role

  • Completed vocational training or university degree with proven track record as HRBP or HR generalist within a production environment for a minimum of five years

  • Possess an enhanced knowledge of MS-office and Workday /SAP

  • Highly self-driven and autonomous with a strong sense of ownership and executions focus

  • Ability to communicate at all levels and hands on mentality

  • You are at ease communicating in German and English ( written and oral)

More about us

We develop cable protection systems for a wide range of market segments worldwide. Our goal is to further strengthen our position in our target markets through targeted development and continuous improvement of our solutions.

We look forward to receiving your application.

The recruitment process is led by Reto Korstick, Talent Partner ABB Switzerland Ltd.

If you want to know more about ABB, please visit our website:
www.abb.com

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Production Supervisor


About the Role and • Responsibilities

In this position, you are responsible for ensuring compliance with process workflows, work instructions, production plans, and quality and safety standards in a 3‑shift operation for the production of miniature circuit breakers (MCBs). You play a key role in maintaining smooth production operations. Working closely with the department management, you help create an effective and efficient working environment.

Work model: Onsite

Location: Electrification Business Area, Schaffhausen

Your Main • Responsibilities

  • Managing capacities, resources, and personnel during the shift while ensuring adherence to safety, quality, and production targets

  • Acting as the primary contact for process‑related questions and ensuring compliance with defined process standards

  • Identifying improvement opportunities in production processes and equipment, and addressing technical, quality‑related, and logistical challenges with a solution‑oriented mindset

  • Motivating and developing the team, and collaborating closely with internal support functions to ensure efficient communication

Your • Qualifications

  • Completed technical apprenticeship

  • Several years of experience in production or production‑related areas

  • Initial leadership experience in a manufacturing environment

  • Knowledge of manufacturing processes and automated production lines

  • Experience with continuous improvement initiatives and Lean‑management methods (e.g., KAIZEN, Lean Six Sigma)

  • Strong analytical skills, resilience, and excellent team behavior

  • Fluent German skills (spoken and written); English skills are an advantage

  • Willingness to work in shifts (currently 3‑shift model, potentially including Saturdays)

  • Strong interpersonal skills and assertiveness

  • ERP knowledge (SAP)

What We Offer

We want you to bring your full potential — your ideas, your energy, your ambition. You will receive the tools and freedom to develop your skills, shape your own path, and take on challenges that truly matter. Your work will have a visible and tangible impact every day.

Benefits

• We offer a range of attractive benefits to support your well‑being and work‑life balance:

  • REKA checks for leisure and travel

  • Company holidays between Christmas and New Year

  • Various discounts related to health and well‑being

  • Contribution toward gym membership

More About Us

ABB Smart Buildings enables optimization of energy efficiency, safety, security and comfort for any building type, through new installations or retrofit solutions. The Division offers integrated digital technologies to control HVAC, lighting, shutters, and security, in addition to energy distribution solutions including DIN rail products, enclosures and emergency lighting through to industrial plugs and sockets and conventional wiring accessories, accommodating for single family homes, multiple dwellings, commercial buildings, infrastructure and industrial applications. The Division’s highly innovative technologies and digital solutions serve rising global demand among real estate developers, owners, and investors for smart building technologies that optimize energy distribution and building automation. The scalable solutions aim to deliver significant sustainable and financial benefits, meeting social and environmental demands, while being able to address even the most complex of customers’ carbon reduction strategies.

The recruitment process is managed by Talent Partner Mara Werne.

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

ABB Motion, a global leader in motors and drives, is at the core of accelerating a more productive and sustainable future. With our digitally enabled drives, motors and services we support our customers and partners to achieve better performance, safety and reliability. To help the world’s industries outrun – leaner and cleaner, we deliver motor-driven solutions for a wide range of applications in all industrial segments. In this role, you will manage the marketing of ABB’s training service offerings for Medium Voltage Drives, targeting defined market segments and ensuring alignment with market needs and business line strategy. You will be accountable for the full lifecycle of the offering portfolio, from development and launch to go-to-market, maintenance, pricing, and profitability.

You will own the long-term profitable growth of the training services portfolio, ensuring offerings are scalable, competitive, and deliver customer value. By collaborating across functions and regions, you will support business results and continuously optimize performance, enabling high-quality service execution and capability development worldwide.

Location

This role is open globally, with preferred locations in Poland, Switzerland, Finland, China, India, and the United States. The work model is hybrid #LI-hybrid.

Key • Responsibilities

  • Own and manage the global training services portfolio for Medium Voltage Drives, ensuring clear service definitions and scalability.
  • Drive full lifecycle management of training services (concept, development, launch, scaling, phase‑out).
  • Define training service roadmap aligned with business line strategy and product lifecycle evolution.
  • Collaborate with sales, service, and regional teams to identify skill gaps and position training as part of service solutions.
  • Translate installed base and modernization needs into targeted training offerings that improve execution and win rates.
  • Enable field teams and customers through structured, role-based training paths and service offerings.
  • Track performance (revenue, utilization, customer satisfaction) and drive continuous improvement and profitability.
  • Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and regulatory standards across global training services

• Qualifications

  • Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Industrial Management, or related field.
  • Several years of experience in training services, adult education, or service product management.
  • Strong understanding of industrial service environments and capability development.
  • Proven experience working in global, cross-functional and matrix organizations.
  • Commercial mindset with ability to manage service portfolios and lifecycle.
  • Strong analytical, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
  • Ability to translate technical/operational needs into scalable service offerings.
  • Customer- and safety-oriented, with proactive and collaborative approach.

We empower you to take the lead, share bold ideas, and shape real outcomes. You’ll grow through hands-on experience, mentorship, and learning that fits your goals. Here, your work doesn’t just matter, it moves things forward.

This position reports to:
Portfolio Manager – Business Line Medium Voltage Drives

__

At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

ABB Motion, a global leader in motors and drives, is at the core of accelerating a more productive and sustainable future. We innovate and push the boundaries of technology to contribute to energy efficient, decarbonizing and circular solutions for customers, industries and societies. With our digitally enabled drives, motors and services we support our customers and partners to achieve better performance, safety and reliability. To help the world’s industries outrun – leaner and cleaner, we deliver motor-driven solutions for a wide range of applications in all industrial segments. Building on over 140 years of domain expertise in electric powertrains, our more than 22,000 employees across 100 countries learn and improve every day. go.abb/motion

In this role, you will manage the marketing of ABB’s training service offerings for Medium Voltage Drives, targeting defined market segments and ensuring alignment with market needs and business line strategy. You will be accountable for the full lifecycle of the offering portfolio, from development and launch to go-to-market, maintenance, pricing, and profitability.

You will own the long-term profitable growth of the training services portfolio, ensuring offerings are scalable, competitive, and deliver customer value. By collaborating across functions and regions, you will support business results and continuously optimize performance, enabling high-quality service execution and capability development worldwide.

Location

This role is open globally, with preferred locations in Poland, Switzerland, Finland, China, India, and the United States. The work model is hybrid #LI-hybrid.

Key
• Responsibilities

- Own and manage the global training services portfolio for Medium Voltage Drives, ensuring clear service definitions and scalability.

- Drive full lifecycle management of training services (concept, development, launch, scaling, phase‑out).

- Define training service roadmap aligned with business line strategy and product lifecycle evolution.

- Collaborate with sales, service, and regional teams to identify skill gaps and position training as part of service solutions.

- Translate installed base and modernization needs into targeted training offerings that improve execution and win rates.

- Enable field teams and customers through structured, role-based training paths and service offerings.

- Track performance (revenue, utilization, customer satisfaction) and drive continuous improvement and profitability.

- Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and regulatory standards across global training services

• Qualifications

- Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Industrial Management, or related field.

- Several years of experience in training services, adult education, or service product management.

- Strong understanding of industrial service environments and capability development.

- Proven experience working in global, cross-functional and matrix organizations.

- Commercial mindset with ability to manage service portfolios and lifecycle.

- Strong analytical, stakeholder management, and communication skills.

- Ability to translate technical/operational needs into scalable service offerings.

- Customer- and safety-oriented, with proactive and collaborative approach.

We empower you to take the lead, share bold ideas, and shape real outcomes. You’ll grow through hands-on experience, mentorship, and learning that fits your goals. Here, your work doesn’t just matter, it moves things forward.

Join us. Be part of the team where progress happens, industries transform, and your work shapes the world. Run What Runs the World.

#ABBCareers

#RunwithABB

#Runwhatrunstheworld

jobs.title: DSM Global Indirect Tax Technology Manager
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Tax Global Process and Transformation Le

__

The Data & Systems Modernization (DSM) Program was launched in April 2025 as a strategic initiative to build a unified, company-wide data and systems framework across ABB. Building on the foundations of the Finance Transformation Program (FTP) and the HR Transformation Program (HRTP), DSM aims to simplify our complex systems landscape, harmonize relevant non-finance master data, and establish a common ERP roadmap for the whole company.

The DSM Global Indirect Tax Technology Manager is a specialist role within the DSM program, forming part of the Indirect Tax Practice Team. The role acts as the single global design authority for indirect tax within enterprise platforms and Business-led transformation programs, ensuring that indirect tax is built in once and built right across the full business lifecycle.

The position partners closely with business areas, finance, IT, transformation programs (DSM and BA initiatives), and external providers to define, standardize, and govern indirect tax determination, controls, and reporting in core systems. The objective is to reduce complexity, risk, and cost while enabling scalable, future ready compliance.

This role is based in Europe and reports to the Global Indirect Tax Practice Lead.

Your • Responsibilities:

  • Act as the single global indirect tax design authority for indirect tax across DSM, BA transformations, and core platforms (ERP, S/4HANA, CFIN).

  • Define and own a standard global indirect tax model covering tax codes, tax triggers, determination logic, and data dependencies.

  • Own global indirect tax determination for AR, AP, and Intercompany processes.

  • Ensure indirect tax is embedded end to end across the business lifecycle: master data, procurement, order management, delivery, billing, and reporting.

  • Enable centralized indirect tax decision making, reducing local deviations, rework, and project delays.

  • Partner with IS and transformation teams to design scalable, future proof solutions aligned with regulatory change (e.g. e invoicing, digital reporting).

  • Leverage core system capabilities (e.g. SAP DRC, CFIN) to ensure consistency and reuse, avoiding bespoke solutions.

  • Improve first-time-right outcomes to reduce audit, compliance and operational risk.

  • Serve as the single global point of contact for indirect tax technology across projects and operations.

  • Enable business growth through automated, compliant and efficient indirect tax processes

Your Experiences:

  • Significant experience in indirect tax technology, ERP tax determination ERP-enabled tax transformations, or indirect tax process design, gained in house and/or in a professional services environment.

  • Typically, 10+ years of progressively responsible experience in tax, including substantial ownership of tax technology, ERP implementations or global transformation initiatives.

  • Solid understanding of indirect tax across business processes, not limited to reporting.

  • Demonstrated experience working with global ERP platforms (e.g. SAP S/4 HANA) and tax related system design.

  • Ability to translate complex tax requirements into scalable system solutions and standards.

  • Experience working in global, multi stakeholder transformation environments.

  • Advanced analytical, problem solving, and decision-making skills.

  • Skilled in clear communication and stakeholder coordination

Desirable Experiences:

  • Experience with digital reporting and e invoicing frameworks (e.g. EU VAT reforms).

  • Exposure to large scale finance or ERP transformation programs.

  • Familiarity with SAP tax and reporting tools (e.g. SAP DRC, CFIN).

Why Join Us

This role offers the opportunity to develop the global indirect tax technology strategy of a multinational organization. The role works closely with senior stakeholders and plays a critical role in delivering compliant, efficient and sustainable indirect tax outcomes globally.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Bei ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder Mensch hier macht das möglich. Sie werden in der Lage sein zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie, das zu führen, was die Welt regiert. Das Data & Systems Modernization (DSM) Programm wurde im April 2025 als strategische Initiative zum Aufbau eines einheitlichen, unternehmensweiten Daten- und Systemrahmens für ABB ins Leben gerufen. Aufbauend auf den Grundlagen des Finance Transformation Program (FTP) und des HR Transformation Program (HRTP) zielt DSM darauf ab, unsere komplexe Systemlandschaft zu vereinfachen, relevante Nicht-Finanz-Stammdaten zu harmonisieren und eine gemeinsame ERP-Roadmap für das gesamte Unternehmen zu erstellen. Der DSM Global Indirect Tax Technology Manager ist eine spezialisierte Rolle innerhalb des DSM-Programms und Teil des Indirect Tax Practice Teams. Die Rolle fungiert als einzige globale Designbehörde für indirekte Steuern innerhalb von Unternehmensplattformen und unternehmensgeführten Transformationsprogrammen und stellt sicher, dass indirekte Steuern einmalig und über den gesamten Geschäftslebenszyklus hinweg eingebaut werden. Die Position arbeitet eng mit Geschäftsbereichen, Finanzen, IT, Transformationsprogrammen (DSM- und BA-Initiativen) und externen Anbietern zusammen, um indirekte Steuerfestsetzung, -kontrollen und -berichterstattung in Kernsystemen zu definieren, zu standardisieren und zu regeln. Ziel ist es, Komplexität, Risiko und Kosten zu reduzieren und gleichzeitig skalierbare, zukunftsfähige Compliance zu ermöglichen. Diese Rolle hat ihren Sitz in Europa und berichtet an den Global Indirect Tax Practice Lead.
• Ihre Aufgaben: - Handeln Sie als einzige globale indirekte Steuergestaltungsbehörde für indirekte Steuern über DSM, BA-Transformationen und Kernplattformen (ERP, S/4HANA, CFIN). Definieren und besitzen Sie ein globales Standardmodell für indirekte Steuern, das Steuercodes, Steuerauslöser, Bestimmungslogik und Datenabhängigkeiten umfasst. - Eigene globale indirekte Steuerermittlung für AR-, AP- und Intercompany-Prozesse. - Sicherstellen, dass indirekte Steuern über den gesamten Geschäftslebenszyklus hinweg eingebettet sind: Stammdaten, Beschaffung, Auftragsverwaltung, Lieferung, Abrechnung und Berichterstattung. Ermöglichen Sie zentralisierte indirekte Steuerentscheidungen, reduzieren Sie lokale Abweichungen, Nacharbeiten und Projektverzögerungen. - Zusammenarbeit mit IS und Transformationsteams, um skalierbare, zukunftssichere Lösungen zu entwickeln, die auf regulatorische Veränderungen ausgerichtet sind (z. B. Rechnungsstellung, digitales Reporting). Nutzen Sie die Kernsystemfähigkeiten (z. B. SAP DRC, CFIN), um Konsistenz und Wiederverwendung zu gewährleisten und maßgeschneiderte Lösungen zu vermeiden. - Verbesserung der ersten Ergebnisse, um Audit-, Compliance- und Betriebsrisiken zu reduzieren. - Dienen Sie als einziger globaler Ansprechpartner für indirekte Steuertechnologie über Projekte und Operationen hinweg. - Ermöglichen Sie Unternehmenswachstum durch automatisierte, konforme und effiziente indirekte Steuerprozesse Ihre Erfahrungen: - Bedeutende Erfahrung in der indirekten Steuertechnologie, ERP-Steuerermittlung ERP-fähige Steuertransformationen oder Prozessgestaltung indirekter Steuern, die im eigenen Haus und / oder in einer professionellen Dienstleistungsumgebung erworben wurden. - Typischerweise 10+ Jahre progressiv verantwortungsvolle Erfahrung im Steuerwesen, einschließlich erheblicher Beteiligung an Steuertechnologie, ERP-Implementierungen oder globalen Transformationsinitiativen. - Solides Verständnis der indirekten Steuern über Geschäftsprozesse hinweg, nicht beschränkt auf die Berichterstattung. - Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit globalen ERP-Plattformen (z. B. SAP S/4 HANA) und dem steuerlichen Systemdesign. - Fähigkeit, komplexe steuerliche
• Anforderungen in skalierbare Systemlösungen und Standards umzusetzen. - Erfahrung in globalen, Multi-Stakeholder-Transformationsumgebungen. - Fortgeschrittene analytische, Problemlösungs- und Entscheidungsfähigkeiten. - Geschickte in klarer Kommunikation und Stakeholder-Koordination Wünschenswerte Erfahrungen: - Erfahrung mit digitaler Berichterstattung und E-Rechnungsrahmen (z. B. EU-Mehrwertsteuerreformen). - Exposition gegenüber großen Finanzierungs- oder ERP-Transformationsprogrammen. - Vertrautheit mit SAP Tax and Reporting Tools (z.B. SAP DRC, CFIN). Warum uns beitreten Diese Rolle bietet die Möglichkeit, die globale Technologiestrategie für indirekte Steuern einer multinationalen Organisation zu entwickeln. Die Rolle arbeitet eng mit hochrangigen Interessengruppen zusammen und spielt eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Bereitstellung konformer, effizienter und nachhaltiger indirekter Steuerergebnisse weltweit. Der Aufbau einer saubereren, intelligenteren Zukunft erfordert alle Arten von Köpfen: das Neugierige, das Mutige und das Kreative. Deshalb begrüßen wir Menschen mit allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen. Bereit, eine Wirkung zu erzielen? Bewerben Sie sich noch heute oder besuchen Sie https://www.abb.com, um mehr über die Auswirkungen unserer Lösungen auf der ganzen Welt zu erfahren.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
A l'ABB, nous aidons les industries à fonctionner de façon plus propre, et chaque personne ici fait que cela arrive. Vous aurez le pouvoir de diriger, de soutenir la croissance et d'être fiers de l'impact que nous créons ensemble. Rejoignez-nous et aidez à gérer ce qui dirige le monde. Ce poste relève de : Tax Global Process and Transformation Le Le Programme de modernisation des données et des systèmes (DSM) a été lancé en avril 2025 dans le cadre d'une initiative stratégique visant à créer un cadre unifié de données et de systèmes à l'échelle de l'entreprise dans l'ensemble de l'ABB. S'appuyant sur les fondements du Programme de transformation des finances (PTF) et du Programme de transformation des RH (PTRH), DSM vise à simplifier notre paysage complexe de systèmes, à harmoniser les données maîtresses non financières pertinentes et à établir une feuille de route commune pour l'ensemble de l'entreprise. Le DSM Global Indirect Tax Technology Manager joue un rôle de spécialiste dans le cadre du programme DSM, qui fait partie de l'équipe des pratiques fiscales indirectes. Le rôle joue le rôle d'autorité de conception mondiale unique en matière de fiscalité indirecte au sein des plates-formes d'entreprises et des programmes de transformation dirigés par les entreprises, en veillant à ce que la fiscalité indirecte soit intégrée une fois et construite tout au long du cycle de vie de l'entreprise. Le poste est étroitement lié aux secteurs d'activité, aux finances, aux TI, aux programmes de transformation (initiatives de MSM et de BA) et aux fournisseurs externes afin de définir, normaliser et régir la détermination, les contrôles et la déclaration des impôts indirects dans les systèmes de base. L'objectif est de réduire la complexité, les risques et les coûts tout en permettant une conformité évolutive et future. Ce rôle est basé en Europe et relève du responsable des pratiques fiscales mondiales indirectes.
• Responsabilités: - Agir comme l'unique autorité mondiale de conception de l'impôt indirect pour l'ensemble des transformations DSM, BA et plates-formes de base (ERP, S/4HANA, CFIN). - Définir et posséder un modèle mondial standard de fiscalité indirecte couvrant les codes fiscaux, les déclencheurs fiscaux, la logique de détermination et les dépendances en matière de données. - Oui. Détermination globale de la fiscalité indirecte pour les processus AR, AP et Intercompany. - S'assurer que la taxe indirecte est intégrée à la fin du cycle de vie de l'entreprise : données maîtresses, achats, gestion des commandes, livraison, facturation et rapports. - Permettre une prise de décision centralisée en matière de fiscalité indirecte, en réduisant les écarts locaux, en retravaillant et en retardant le projet. - Établir des partenariats avec les équipes de l'IS et de la transformation pour concevoir des solutions évolutives et futures, alignées sur les changements réglementaires (p. ex. facturation, rapports numériques). - Tirer parti des capacités du système central (par exemple SAP RDC, CFIN) pour assurer la cohérence et la réutilisation, en évitant les solutions sur mesure. - Améliorer les résultats de première fois pour réduire les risques de vérification, de conformité et de fonctionnement. - Servir de point de contact mondial unique pour les technologies fiscales indirectes dans tous les projets et opérations. - Favoriser la croissance des entreprises grâce à des processus de fiscalité indirecte automatisés, conformes et efficaces Vos expériences : - Expérience importante dans la technologie de la fiscalité indirecte, la détermination de la taxe ERP Les transformations fiscales ERP, ou la conception de processus de fiscalité indirecte, acquises en maison et/ou dans un environnement de services professionnels. - Typiquement, 10 ans et plus d'expérience progressivement responsable en matière d'impôt, y compris la propriété substantielle de la technologie fiscale, la mise en œuvre de PGI ou des initiatives de transformation mondiale. - Une bonne compréhension de l'impôt indirect dans tous les processus commerciaux, sans se limiter à la déclaration. - Expérience démontrée de travail avec les plateformes ERP mondiales (par exemple SAP S/4 HANA) et la conception du système fiscal. - Capacité de traduire des exigences fiscales complexes en solutions et en normes évolutives. - Expérience de travail dans des environnements de transformation mondiaux et multi-acteurs. - Compétences avancées en analyse, résolution de problèmes et prise de décisions. - Compétence en communication claire et coordination avec les parties prenantes Expériences souhaitables: - Expérience en matière de rapports numériques et de cadres de facturation (par exemple, réformes de la TVA dans l'UE). - Exposition à des programmes de financement à grande échelle ou de transformation des ERP. - Connaissance des outils de déclaration et d'imposition SAP (par exemple SAP RDC, CFIN). Pourquoi nous rejoindre Ce rôle offre l'occasion de développer la stratégie mondiale en matière de technologies fiscales indirectes d'une organisation multinationale. Ce rôle travaille en étroite collaboration avec les intervenants de haut niveau et joue un rôle essentiel dans l'obtention de résultats fiscaux indirects conformes, efficaces et durables à l'échelle mondiale. Construire un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent prend toutes sortes d'esprits : les curieux, les courageux et les créatifs. C'est pourquoi nous accueillons des gens de tous horizons et expériences. Prêt à avoir un impact ? Faites une demande aujourd'hui ou visitez https://www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur l'impact de nos solutions à travers le monde.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Production Supervisor

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to support the unit in meeting the set production targets by adhering to the systems and processes. Each day, you will use machinery and equipment on the shop floor. You will also show skill in reading and interpreting the technical diagrams/instructions for assembly of products/systems/panels.

The work model for the role is: #LI-onsite

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Assembly and wiring of modules and systems according to documentation and instructions

  • Delivery of the required quality while adhering to safety regulations, deadlines, and time specifications

  • Clarification of open points with preceding or subsequent departments, as well as preparation of red‑line corrections

  • Compliance with all applicable safety regulations and company operating procedures

• Qualifications for the role:

  • Completed apprenticeship as an automation technician, electromechanics, automation assembler, assembly electrician, electrician, or a comparable qualification

  • Several years of relevant professional experience, e.g., in switchgear assembly

  • Self-motivated and initiative-driven working style

  • Practical approach; employees take initiative and adjust well to changes

  • High-quality work approach and experience handling materials and electrical tools

  • EDV skills to work on your own (digital document processing / basic SAP knowledge / Teams / Outlook)

  • Fluent German skills and good English skills (both written and spoken) are an advantage

More about us

ABB Motion provides innovative technology, products, solutions and related services to industrial customers to increase energy efficiency, improve safety and reliability, and maintain precise control over processes. The portfolio includes motors, generators and drives for a wide range of applications in all industrial sectors.

The recruiting process is led by Talent Partner Mara Werne.

If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.

Call to action

Be part of something bigger. This is where progress is powered, teams initiate action, and we move the world forward together. Run What Runs the World.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

  • Completed vocational training as a plastics technologist or toolmaker

  • At least 5 years of practical experience in injection molding and extrusion, including machine setup, start-up, and troubleshooting

  • Skilled in setting up, adjusting, and optimizing injection molding machines, tools, hot runner systems, and process parameters

  • Market-rate salary, plus bonus, 13th-month pay, and participation opportunities (ESAP)

  • Sustainability and mobility benefits, including an eco-bonus for employees who do not commute by car

  • Discounts such as REKA checks, Swibeco benefits, and Felfel food vending machines

About Us

ABB Installation Products Division (formerly Thomas&Betts), helps manage the connection, protection and distribution of electrical power from source to socket. The Commercial Essentials product segment includes electrical junction boxes, commercial fittings, strut and cable tray metal framing systems for commercial and residential construction. The Premier Industrial product segment includes multiple product lines, such as Ty-Rap® cable ties, T&B Liquidtight Systems® protection products, PVC coated and nylon conduit systems, power connection and grounding systems, and cable protection systems of conduits and fittings for harsh and industrial applications. The Division also manufactures solutions for medium-voltage applications used in the utility market under its marquee brands including Elastimold™ reclosers and switchgear, capacitor switches, current limiting fuses, Homac™ distribution connectors, Hi-Tech Valiant™ full-range current limiting fuse for fire mitigation, faulted current indicators and distribution connectors, cable accessories and apparatus with products for overhead and underground distribution. jobs.title: Global Business Line Manager - Traction Products
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

President Traction Division

__

At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

As part of our ambitious growth, we are hiring a new Global Business Line Manager, for our Traction Products business line, part of our Motion Traction Division. This role is open globally, and preferred locations are set close to our main Traction locations in Switzerland, Germany, Italy, Sweden, France, Poland.

This Position reports to: President Traction Division

As Global Business Line Manager, Traction Products, you will hold end-to-end accountability for a uniquely positioned and strategically critical product portfolio spanning Traction Motors, Energy Storage Systems (ESS), Auxiliary Converters, and DC-DC Converters.

This is a pivotal enterprise leadership role with responsibility for shaping the future of the product business within the division, advancing commercial excellence, and delivering sustainable, profitable growth across global markets.

Reporting directly to the Division President, you will lead a geographically diverse organization and set the strategic direction for the end-to-end Traction Products business line across its four Product Lines: Traction Motors, Energy Storage Solutions (ESS), Auxiliary Converters, and Brightloop.

You will steer the full value chain, from the performance and direction of Product Line-owned factories and embedded capabilities such as R&D, Engineering, and Product Management to commercial execution, while accelerating growth, strengthening customer relevance, and building long-term competitive advantage globally.

Key • Responsibilities

  • Own full P&L accountability for the Global Traction Products business line, driving sustainable growth, profitability, and cash performance.

  • Lead the strategic evolution and scaling of a competitive product portfolio across motors, ESS, DC-DC converters, and auxiliary systems, strengthening value propositions and market positioning across target segments.

  • Set clear accountability across Product Lines for factories, product management, and engineering, while ensuring alignment with business line priorities and enterprise objectives.

  • Define and execute global go-to-market strategies that expand market share, reinforce pricing discipline, and deepen customer intimacy across segments and regions.

  • Establish and drive performance targets that promote a culture of quality, continuous improvement, and operational excellence across the organization.

  • Champion high-impact marketing, sales, and customer engagement strategies that elevate market presence and accelerate growth.

  • Strengthen relationships with key customers and OEMs, positioning ABB as the partner of choice for traction and onboard energy solutions.

  • Lead the successful integration of acquired entities into ABB, realizing targeted value creation, synergies, and organizational alignment.

  • Ensure best-in-class operational performance across manufacturing, supply chain, quality, delivery, and HSE, aligned with ABB’s standards and business ambitions.

  • Build and develop high-performing, values-driven teams through coaching, talent development, and robust succession planning.

• Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in engineering, Business Administration, or related field.

  • Proven success leading global business lines or holding significant P&L responsibility within industrial, rail, mobility, or comparable sectors.

  • Strong strategic and commercial acumen, with a demonstrated ability to scale complex product portfolios and translate strategy into measurable business results.

  • Experience leading multi-product, technology-driven businesses with a manufacturing footprint and end-to-end operational accountability.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead a Product Line–driven operating model with distributed ownership, embedded capabilities, and strong enterprise alignment.

  • Strong understanding of customer ecosystems across multiple industries, with the ability to anticipate market shifts and shape competitive positioning.

  • Proven leadership of large, cross-regional organizations, with the ability to align diverse teams around a shared vision and performance agenda.

  • Track record of delivering results in fast-paced environments with complex operational structures, balancing speed, rigor, and execution excellence.

  • Experience in M&A and integration, ideally with direct leadership in integration programs and delivery of targeted value creation.

  • High personal integrity and a strong commitment to ABB’s values, ethics, and compliance standards, serving as a role model for principled leadership.

  • Skilled in leading change and transformation, while fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and organizational resilience.

  • Adept at stakeholder management, with strong communication and influencing skills at executive, board, and cross-functional leadership levels.

  • Passion for people, customers, quality, and technology, with a leadership mindset grounded in impact and long-term value creation.

  • Ability to develop people and lead with clarity, purpose, and consistency.

#ABBCareers

#RunwithABB

#Runwhatrunstheworld

ABB Motion, a global leader in motors and drives, is at the core of accelerating a more productive and sustainable future. We innovate and push the boundaries of technology to contribute to energy efficient, decarbonizing and circular solutions for customers, industries and societies. With our digitally enabled drives, motors and services we support our customers and partners to achieve better performance, safety and reliability. To help the world’s industries outrun – leaner and cleaner, we deliver motor-driven solutions for a wide range of applications in all industrial segments. Building on over 140 years of domain expertise in electric powertrains, our more than 22,000 employees across 100 countries learn and improve every day. go.abb/motion

• Eigene volle Gewinn- und Verlustverantwortung für den Geschäftsbereich Global Traction Products, Förderung von nachhaltigem Wachstum, Rentabilität und Cash-Performance. - Leiten Sie die strategische Weiterentwicklung und Skalierung eines wettbewerbsfähigen Produktportfolios für Motoren, ESS, DC-DC-Wandler und Hilfssysteme und stärken Sie Wertversprechen und Marktpositionierung in allen Zielsegmenten. - Legen Sie in allen Produktlinien klare Verantwortlichkeiten für Fabriken, Produktmanagement und Technik fest und stellen Sie gleichzeitig die Ausrichtung auf die Prioritäten der Geschäftsbereiche und Unternehmensziele sicher. - Definieren und implementieren Sie globale Markteinführungsstrategien, die den Marktanteil vergrößern, die Preisdisziplin stärken und die Kundennähe über Segmente und Regionen hinweg vertiefen. - Legen Sie Leistungsziele fest und fördern Sie diese, um eine Kultur der Qualität, kontinuierlichen Verbesserung und operativen Exzellenz im gesamten Unternehmen zu fördern. - Verfechten Sie wirkungsvolle Marketing-, Vertriebs- und Kundenbindungsstrategien, die die Marktpräsenz erhöhen und das Wachstum beschleunigen. - Stärkung der Beziehungen zu wichtigen Kunden und OEMs und Positionierung von ABB als bevorzugter Partner für Traktions- und Bordenergielösungen. - Führen Sie die erfolgreiche Integration erworbener Einheiten in ABB und realisieren Sie gezielte Wertschöpfung, Synergien und organisatorische Ausrichtung. - Gewährleisten Sie eine erstklassige Betriebsleistung in den Bereichen Fertigung, Lieferkette, Qualität, Lieferung und HSE, im Einklang mit den Standards und Geschäftsambitionen von ABB. - Aufbau und Entwicklung leistungsstarker, werteorientierter Teams durch Coaching, Talententwicklung und solide Nachfolgeplanung.

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Field Service Engineer


Your role and responsibilities

As a Service Engineer, you will execute service work on rolling stock and energy storing systems with low to medium complexity according to work instructions and in accordance with ABB standard processes, quality standards and safety guidelines. You will be in close cooperation with customers and other ABB teams, acting as the technical point while delivering quality and satisfying customer service.

Reporting to the Head of Field Service, you will be responsible for providing routine maintenance and on-site or remote technical support. The position involves approximately 50 days of domestic and 30 days of international travel, as you will be providing hands-on assistance at customer sites.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

The main responsibilities include

  • Performing service tasks like installation and commissioning of equipment, identifying technical problems, making analysis through remote or on-site activity in different service categories (installation and commissioning, routine maintenance, extensions, replacements etc.)
  • Consulting with and advising customers on the best service solutions in accordance with standard processes, procedures, and safety guidelines. Furthermore creating and maintaining strong relationships with customers, appreciating their needs, and providing specialist assistance and solutions
  • Coordinating and executing specialist projects through planning, meeting milestones and regular reviews
  • Troubleshooting simple equipment failure and making recommendations to avoid repeating the problem in the future. Identifying opportunities to develop new service applications, equipment and methods

• Qualifications for the role

  • Four years of experience in electrical work, testing, maintenance, or service, working as test- or commissioning engineer with power electronics or on electrical vehicles
  • Knowledge and hands-on experience in servicing, maintaining, commissioning and repairing of power electronic products
  • Ability to travel worldwide
  • Proven leadership skills, with a collaborative, solution-focused approach and strong written and spoken communication skills
  • A technician or engineer bachelor’s degree in electrotechnics
  • Required language skills are fluent German, French, and English

More about us

ABB Traction Division is a recognized leader in onboard propulsion technologies that drive innovation in rail, bus, and industrial vehicle electrification. A comprehensive range of high-performance and full lifecycle managed propulsion, auxiliary and energy storage solutions help improve energy efficiency and contribute to making transportation more sustainable. We all together make the difference for our customers every day. We look forward to receiving your application.

If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com. ABB Data Privacy Statement: https://new.abb.com/privacy-notice/candidate

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: Sales Specialist OEM (Talent Pool) | 80–100%
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Sales Manager


Important remark: This position is open for ongoing talent sourcing; while we are not actively hiring for this role at the moment, we welcome applications to build our future talent pipeline.

Your role and responsibilities:

You will be responsible for sales of electrification, low voltage, and control products in the automation and machine manufacturing segment for the Swiss OEM market, ensuring growth in sales volumes and margins. Reporting to the Head of Sales OEM Electrification, you will leverage your expertise to build lasting customer relationships through outstanding service.

The work model for the role is: #hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Drive sales by managing existing accounts, acquiring new customers, and collaborating with marketing, technical support, and sales teams to develop sales plans and identify market opportunities.

  • Leverage your knowledge of customers’ applications and ABB solutions to address needs, focusing on digitalization, Industry 4.0, and energy efficiency, ensuring technical and financial accuracy.

  • Partner closely with ABB distribution channels to enhance customer journey and maintain precise customer data within the CRM system (Salesforce).

  • Continuously expand your technical expertise, monitor market trends, and apply diverse sales techniques such as value-based selling to maximize business success.


• Qualifications for the role:

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in technical sales

  • Strong technical expertise in low voltage products, with a solid understanding of the Swiss industry and automation.

  • Proficiency in Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems; experience with order development tools (ERP) is a plus.

  • Demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong customer relationships, paired with a collaborative, solution-oriented mindset.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with fluency in German and English; French is an advantage.

  • Technical qualification, preferably a bachelor's degree in Automation, Electrical, or Mechanical Engineering.

  • Valid Swiss driver’s license and work authorization in Switzerland.


More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers,
low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

The recruitment is led by Reto Korstick at ABB Switzerland, Ltd.

A Future Opportunity
Please note that this position is part of our talent pipeline and not an active job opening at this time. By applying, you express your interest in future career opportunities with ABB.

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about us and see the impact of our work across the globe.

jobs.title: (Senior) Research Scientist in Software Systems Engineering (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Research Team Manager - Industrial Software Systems

__

Your role and responsibilities

As a research scientist in Software Systems Engineering, you will be working on the future architecture and design of ABB’s software-based products, with a special focus on the digitalization of industrial systems. We are looking for a team member with a proven research track record and the eagerness to transfer and apply world class academic research into an industrial environment. You will work within the highly motivated, international team of scientists at ABB Research. • We offer an open and innovative international work environment with many diverse opportunities to grow your career.

The work model for the role is: #LI-hybrid


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Contribute to and/or lead research projects that turn state-of-the-art research results into effective software solutions for ABB.
  • Create prototypes of innovative concepts with real business impact
  • Evaluate new technologies and assess their impact on ABB products and roadmaps.
  • Disseminate your results in scientific publications, patent applications, and technical reports.
  • Build a network in the company and actively disseminate your knowledge and expertise.


• Qualifications for the role

  • PhD in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering or in a related field

  • Experience in software engineering and system design
  • Theoretical and practical knowledge in one or multiple of the following topics: software engineering, distributed systems, computer networking, embedded systems, machine learning, cyber security
  • Hands-on experience in programming languages (e.g., C/C++, Python, Rust)
  • Proven publication track record at top scientific conferences and journals
  • Excellent communication skills and team player attitude
  • Solid experience of getting ideas from concepts to prototypes


Benefits

We also offer our employees the following benefits:
  • Flexible Work Practices
  • Employee Share Acquisition Plan
  • Canteen

More about us


At the ABB Research Center located in Baden-Dättwil in the proximity of Zurich, we work on cutting-edge technologies that shape the future of our products. The Industrial Software Systems research team explores topics like machine learning, cybersecurity, computer networking, distributed systems, and real-time systems. Our solutions are used to support the development of next-generation digital products and services of ABB.

We look forward to receiving your application (documents submitted in English are appreciated). If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.

What's in it for you:

We empower you to take initiative, explore new possibilities, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: Sales Engineer, French Fluency Required (80–100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Local Division Manager

__

Your Role and • Responsibilities

In this role, you will spend approximately 80% of your time at customer sites. You will acquire new business partners and continuously develop existing customer relationships. By leveraging your technical expertise and sales experience, you will understand customer needs and clearly articulate the value of our electric motors and variable frequency drives (low voltage and medium voltage).

As a key driver of growth in our drives business, you will succeed through knowledgeable consulting and clear value‑based selling—ranging from energy efficiency to CO₂ reduction. Your objective is to deliver solutions that are not only technically strong but also contribute to a more sustainable and environmentally responsible industry.

This role follows a hybrid work model. #LI‑Hybrid

Key • Responsibilities

  • Customer Acquisition & Account Management: Spend approximately 80% of your time on site with customers, identifying new business opportunities and expanding existing customer relationships.

  • Technical Consulting: Advise customers on electric motors and variable frequency drives (LV & MV) and present solutions tailored to their technical and business requirements.

  • Value Communication: Clearly communicate the benefits of our products, including improved energy efficiency and reduced CO₂ emissions.

  • Relationship Management: Build trust, identify key stakeholders, and strategically position our solutions.

  • Market & Industry Awareness: Monitor trends in the drives and motion industry and contribute innovative ideas.

Your • Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or technical training in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a comparable field.

  • Several years of experience in sales, with strong knowledge of electric motors and variable frequency drives (LV & MV).

  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills.

  • Willingness to travel extensively (approximately 80% field‑based).

  • Strong interest in energy efficiency and sustainable solutions.

  • Fluent in German and French.

What We Offer

  • An exciting sales role with significant autonomy and impact.

  • Access to innovative products and solutions within the Motion business area.

  • Ongoing learning opportunities and attractive career development prospects.

  • Modern work tools and flexible work arrangements.

More about us

ABB Motors and Drives offers a comprehensive portfolio of motors, generators, and drive products for a wide range of industries and applications. Our mission is to be a trusted expert in automated industrial systems, with a strong focus on reliability, long‑term partnerships, and a deep understanding of our customers’ needs.

The recruitment process is led by Ece Özen, Talent Partner, ABB Switzerland Ltd.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: Service Technician (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Maintenance Team Leader


Your Role and • Responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to support the maintenance team by carrying out daily activities in accordance with agreed maintenance guidelines and procedures. You will contribute your technical skills to increase the overall efficiency of equipment and production lines across our highly automated machinery landscape.

Work model: Onsite

This position supports the Electrification, Smart Buildings, Energy Distribution business in Schaffhausen.

Your • Responsibilities

  • Diagnosing and resolving mechanical, electrical, and pneumatic issues on equipment within our diverse and highly automated machinery park

  • Performing preventive maintenance and servicing of production equipment

  • Working closely with production cells as well as collaborating with Production Engineering and external service providers

  • Contributing to and implementing continuous improvement initiatives within the production environment

  • Supporting improvements in Lean Management practices

Your • Qualifications

  • Completed apprenticeship as an automation technician, mechatronics technician, polymechanic, production mechanic, electrician, or a comparable technical qualification

  • At least 10 years of experience diagnosing and repairing production and assembly equipment (mechanical / electrical / pneumatic)

  • NIV13 or NIV15 installation authorization is an advantage, or willingness to obtain it (costs covered by ABB)

  • Engages constructively with coworkers, communicates clearly, maintains high motivation, and organizes work without close supervision

  • Basic knowledge of MS Office and SAP

  • Fluent German skills; basic English skills are an advantage

  • Willingness to work in a 3‑shift system with on‑call duty after an intensive onboarding period

Benefits

• We offer our employees a range of attractive benefits, including:

  • Salary and bonus structure that includes a 13th‑month payment and participation in an employee share program (ESAP)

  • Professional development through targeted training and career advancement opportunities

  • Sustainability and mobility benefits: eco‑bonus for employees who do not commute by car

  • Discounts such as REKA checks, Swibeco benefits, and access to Felfel food vending machines

More About Us

ABB Smart Buildings enables optimization of energy efficiency, safety, security and comfort for any building type, through new installations or retrofit solutions. The Division offers integrated digital technologies to control HVAC, lighting, shutters, and security, in addition to energy distribution solutions including DIN rail products, enclosures and emergency lighting through to industrial plugs and sockets and conventional wiring accessories, accommodating for single family homes, multiple dwellings, commercial buildings, infrastructure and industrial applications. The Division’s highly innovative technologies and digital solutions serve rising global demand among real estate developers, owners, and investors for smart building technologies that optimize energy distribution and building automation. The scalable solutions aim to deliver significant sustainable and financial benefits, meeting social and environmental demands, while being able to address even the most complex of customers’ carbon reduction strategies.

The recruitment process is managed by Talent Partner Mara Werne.

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.
